summary: Play Brand then Offering+/Battle Trance+ turn 1-2, spread damage across all three segments, blocking the WRITHE/CONSTRICT turns, then kill all three in one turn (Ampoule) so none reattaches at 25 HP. Keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: Front's WRITHE/CONSTRICT turns (12 + 8) and any turn after BULK stacks: block fully. Damage grows each cycle, so don't stall — hold Explosive Ampoule for the turn all three segments die together.

summary: Doom-clock race: Bash+ early for vulnerable, then burst using Offering/Bloodletting. Fully block the 29 bite; free reward turns for damage. Keep sandpit above 0 — play Frantic Escape when ≤2.
key_turns: LUNGING_BITE 29: full block or dex potion. LIQUIFY/SALIVATE buff turns: no attack, all-in damage. Sandpit ≤2: play Frantic Escape before attacking; never let it hit 0.

summary: Drink Strength Potion early. Focus Flail Knight to stop buffs, then Magi before Magic Bomb. Block big hits with Blood Wall+/Expect a Fight; use Offering+/Battle Trance+ to set up.
key_turns: Dangerous: MAGIC_BOMB 35, FLAIL 21. Stack block with Blood Wall+/Expect a Fight. Kill Flail first to stop War Chant; Strength Potion turn 1-2.

summary: Turns 1-2 are unweakened and Queen idle: play Offering+/Mayhem/Brand and land full-value attacks on both. Then focus Amalgam (~199) while blocking ~25/turn; after, block Queen's spikes and race her with Duplicator value.
key_turns: T1-2: no weak/shield — dump attacks + powers, block Amalgam 26/18. Then kill Amalgam (~199) while Queen idles. After it dies: burst the free ENRAGE turn, full-block her 7x5/EXECUTION.

summary: Turn 1 Inflame, then race: block CRASH turns fully, attack hard on THRASH/buff turns. Save Vulnerable potion for a full attack turn near the 70-HP stun; keep HP since the boss follows in 4 floors.
key_turns: Full block on CRASH turns (23+); dump attacks on THRASH turn (10+buff). Push below 70 HP just before a CRASH: the stun cancels it.

summary: T1 setup Inflame+Unmovable (BECKON deals no damage). Fully block DE_GAS 20; on SCREAM 13 boss is intangible - block, skip attacks. Bash+ then dump attacks on free turns. True Grit eats Beckons.
key_turns: T2 DE_GAS 20: full block. T5 SCREAM 13: boss intangible after FADE - block, skip attacks. Free turns (BECKON, GAZE, FADE): Bash+ then dump attacks; True Grit eats Beckons.

summary: Use Hot Cocoa energy turn 1 for Inflame + Unmovable, focus the middle segment, keep re-killing 25-HP reattached segments, block 24+ every turn, block potion for buffed turns.
key_turns: T1: 24 incoming, Anchor plus doubled True Grit+ covers it. Later BULK strength stacks; kill any segment at 25 HP to cancel its attack.

summary: Play Inflame+ and Unmovable on the opening buff turn, then race 321 HP: Bash for vulnerable, twin strikes and strength-scaled hits. Keep the sandpit above 2 with escape cards, block the 29/21 turns, Duplicator for the burst.
key_turns: Buff turns (Liquify/Salivate) are free: build powers and escapes. Fully block LUNGING_BITE 29 and THRASH 21/18. Play FRANTIC_ESCAPE whenever sandpit ≤2, before attacking.

summary: Set up Inflame+ and Unmovable+ turn 1, focusing Magi Knight to stop MAGIC_BOMB. Use potions on T5 big hit. Then kill Flail, then Spectral.
key_turns: T5: MAGIC_BOMB 35 + Flail 15 + Spectral 9 = 59 damage; pre-block with Impervious/Flame Barrier or kill Magi by T4. T2 also 30 damage.

summary: Long 300 HP fight: play Inflame+ then Unmovable+ early, block Charge with Anchor/Diadem block. Artifact 3 makes Bash/Taunt/Dominate vulnerable near-useless, so just attack. Dump damage on the free WINDUP turn and hold big block for HEAVY_C…
key_turns: CHARGE 25 now: block, then powers. Turn 3 WINDUP is free: full attacks plus pre-block. Turn 4 HEAVY_CLEAVE 43 needs Impervious/Flame Barrier; rhythm relic caps loss at 20 but don't lean on it.

summary: Turn 1 powers (Inflame+, Unmovable+), Bash+ then Dominate for burst strength. Race phase 1, fully block phase-2 Multi-Claw, phase 3 use multi-hit attacks and burst when intangible drops; prep on respawn turns.
key_turns: P1 hits 20-28: T1 Anchor/Diadem block covers, else eat ≤20 (Rhythm Reserve). P2 Multi-Claw 30→60: full block, race. P3 intangible: multi-hit, burst when it lapses; enter with ≥40 HP.

summary: Play Inferno on the free first turn, then Bash+ into Molten Fist for doubled vulnerability and race the boss down; keep HP above the eruption count. Hold Fortifier for the self-destruct turn and fully block it.
key_turns: T1 is a free buff turn: Inferno + Bash+. T2 Molten Fist doubles vuln to 6. Block Pressure Gun 22. EXPLODE turn: play all block, then Fortifier; Brew first if hand lacks block.

summary: Race Byrdonis: turn 1 Bloodletting+Crimson Mantle+Bash, then Twin Strike/Bully with Vulnerable. Powdered Demise early. Block SWOOP turns; Dexterity on big hits, Fortifier if HP low. Kill by turn 5.
key_turns: Turn 4 SWOOP with strength is the biggest hit; block fully or Fortify. Kill by turn 5; don't skip attacks on PECK turns.

summary: Sleep turn 1 is free: play Hellraiser and Crimson Mantle for lasting value. Race its 127 HP while blocking the 23-damage slashes each turn; prefer few high-damage cards to limit Slow. No potions held.
key_turns: Turn 1 asleep: play both powers, free damage. Then SLASHES 23 each turn: block ~23 via Mantle + Defends/Taunt while attacking; keep cards lean (Slow raises its damage); race it down.

summary: T1 play Hellraiser + Crimson Mantle, then strip 8 Slippery with Twin Strike/Thunderclap; block hard on Dismember turns, burst on PREPARE, protect HP for later acts.
key_turns: T3/T7 Dismember 27+Wounds: full block; T4 PREPARE: all-out attack. Ashwater to clear Wounds/dead cards.

summary: No powers to set up, so this is a fast slugfest: Bash early for vulnerable, throw Pommel Strike/Anger/Strikes for damage, and block 15+ every turn with Blood Wall and Defends so HP survives into the rest site next.
key_turns: Every turn hits 17+ and grows ~1/turn; never skip blocking — Blood Wall plus Defends each turn, Bash early for vulnerable, leftover energy into Pommel/Anger; kill by turn 4-5.

summary: 开局先上地狱狂徒+撕裂，用飞剑回旋镖/拆卸等多段攻击破8层滑溜；T3/T7只防不打；T4起上易伤接重锤爆发速杀，流动铜液早喝吃荆棘。
key_turns: T2 墨水长枪两段要格挡；T3/T7 肢解27+3伤口：全力格挡不贪伤害；T4 蓄力无来袭，重锤/无情猛攻全打；滑溜破层前勿用重锤。

summary: 21 HP vs 161: survival first. Block 15/11 turns, chip with leftover energy; play Hellraiser/Rupture/Pyre only on the 8-damage turn or with block covered. Flex potion to end the fight a turn early; rest after.
key_turns: JAB/WHIRLWIND 15 and RADIATE 11 turns: full block (Shrug It Off, Blood Wall, Fisticuffs) then chip. PULSATE 8+buff turn: play powers, attack freely. Flex on burst/kill turn.

summary: Turn 1 play Inferno (no attack). Then block the 20/13 turns fully, attack on Beckon/Gaze turns with Bash+Bully; Tear Asunder scales off Inferno HP loss; Ashwater clears Beckon.
key_turns: DE_GAS 20 and SCREAM 13: full block, no greed; FADE (intangible): no attacks, play powers; BECKON/GAZE turns: Bash+Bully; Ashwater exhausts Beckon cards before they hit.

summary: Play Inflame+, Unmovable, Stone Armor early; then grind both claws evenly with AOE, fully blocking LASER 43 and big hits, and kill both in one turn for the finish.
key_turns: ROCKET LASER 43 and Crusher 20+ turns: full block, no trading. Keep claws near-equal HP; finish both same turn or 99 block +6 str. Prefer Bludgeon/Whirlwind burst late.

summary: Race the 62 HP elite after a free setup turn: both Stone Armors first for 8 Plating, then attacks; block LASH 16 with Shrug. Save Binding and Demise for the 252 HP boss; Ampoule for the death-spawn adds.
key_turns: T1 free INFECT turn: play both Stone Armors. LASH 16 comes every other turn; Shrug + Plating covers it. Elite death spawns adds — Breakthrough and Ampoule are for them.

summary: Race the four Wrigglers: use the free stun turn for Stone Armor, then focus the weakest (17 HP) to cut incoming 8/turn. Block hard on bite turns; Binding for a bite turn, Demise emergency/boss.
key_turns: T1 free stun: play Stone Armor. T2 four bites (32): full block, kill the 17 HP Wriggler. Wriggle turns deal no damage — all-out attack. Second bite wave ~T4.

summary: Race: Bash+ then Hemokinesis into vulnerability, both Stone Armors within first 2-3 turns (8 plated/turn), block SWOOP turns only. Save Demise potion for the 252 HP act boss.
key_turns: Block SWOOP turns (18+), accept PECK chip damage. Kill by turn 4-5 before Territorial strength snowballs; keep HP >= 35.

summary: Race the beast: turn 1 play Crimson Mantle + both Stone Armors and drink Demise; Bash+ then Molten Fist doubles Vulnerable to 6; burst under 150 for the free stun, then block every big hit and grind with Hemokinesis.
key_turns: T1-2 free (STAMP/low PLOW): drop powers + Demise. Burst below 150 to trigger the stun; Ringing turn play one big card. Fully block PLOW 20-24 and post-stun STOMP/CRUSH with strength.

summary: T1 无攻击：先绯红披风+和岩石铠甲。用痛击+→熔融之拳翻倍易伤→主宰换约7力量，之后拆卸/御血术/突破+速攻；来袭≥20 全挡，不靠燃烧之血换血。
key_turns: T3起 OVERWHELMING(29+)/SLAP 递增，巨像+、坚毅+、大格挡留给这两回合；T5/T9 诅咒回合无攻击，全力输出；PONDER 每4回合回30，绝不能拖。

summary: Turn 1: Inferno while it sleeps; block 23-damage slash turns fully; on free turns apply vuln and stack self-damage attacks (Inferno +6 each, Slow rewards many cards). Demise early, Strength Potion on the burst; preserve HP for the Kin boss.
key_turns: SLASHES 23 turns (often back-to-back): full block, no HP trading. SLEEP/WAKE turns are free: apply Bash+ vuln, then Hemokinesis/Breakthrough/Whirlwind (Inferno adds 6 each per HP loss).

summary: Turn 1 play Inferno, then use Hemokinesis/Breakthrough to trigger its AOE and clear both followers by turn 3-4. Block the double-slash plus priest beam turns, then Bash+/vulnerable race the priest before Ritual strength stacks; stay above …
key_turns: Turns 3-4: both followers hit 7+7 while priest beams/orbs — full block; kill both followers by then via Whirlwind/Inferno; after that priest RITUAL ramps, so race before beams grow.

summary: Play Inferno early: our self-damage (Breakthrough, Hemokinesis) plus its own tick becomes 6 AOE, and Mr. Cuddles adds turn-number AOE. Block turn 1's 24, keep segment HP even, then kill all three in one turn; Flex/Attack potions on that bu…
key_turns: T1: block their 24 with Inferno down. Their BULK buffs stack (+6 str), so finish by ~turn 6: keep segment HP even, kill all three in one Whirlwind+Flex burst; never solo-kill (reattaches 25).

summary: T1 curse turn: play Inferno, Feel No Pain and Power Potion (Demon Form/Inflame). Then race using self-damage cards (Hemokinesis, Breakthrough, Tear Asunder); block slap/overwhelm turns; kill before heals stack.
key_turns: T2 slap 19 & T3 overwhelm 29: block hard (Colossus+, Evil Eye+); T4/T8 ponder heals+str; curse T1/T5/T9 free — dump damage. Kill by ~T9.

summary: Play Inferno (then Feel No Pain) turns 1-2 while only ~21 incoming; self-damage plus AOE and Mr. Hugs grind all three knights. Focus Magi Knight to delete the 35 bomb, block Flail's 21s, keep HP above ~40.
key_turns: Magi: RAM→PREP→MAGIC_BOMB 35 — kill it before that or full block; Flail's FLAIL 21 chunks; T3 lipstick buff. Inferno turns convert every self-hit into 6 AOE.

summary: Open with Inferno and Feel No Pain, strip Artifact 3 with Bash/Taunt before Molten Fist, block Ebb and Eye Lasers, dump attacks only on boss's unblocked turns.
key_turns: Turn 1 Ebb: 22 incoming plus boss gains 33 block, so turn 2 attacks are wasted — play skills. Eye Lasers turns need full block. Kill before 3rd Increasing Intensity (~turn 9).

summary: T1 Ritual->Stone Armor+->Howl; Howl then hits 18 free each turn. It wakes and wastes its next turn buffing - attack freely after. Then fully block the 23s, keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: Wake turn (next enemy turn) buffs and does not attack - dump damage. From then on it Slashes 23 every turn: fully block with Evil Eye/Defends; plated armor gives 6/turn.

summary: Race the 83 HP bird: T1 Ritual+Stone Armor++Howl (free 18 each end of turn, doubled by Bash+ vuln), then all attacks; block SWOOP turns; keep vulnerble potion for the Kin boss.
key_turns: T1 set up (take ~11 after plating), T2 Bash+ then attacks, block SWOOP with Evil Eye; end by T3-4 before its strength ramps; potion only if the fight drags.

summary: T1 setup Ritual→Howl→Stone Armor+: free 18 AOE recurs every turn. Then Bash/Thrash the 62 HP parasite; full-block LASH 16; hold Whirlwind for the spawn wave. Save vulnerable potion for The Kin.
key_turns: INFECT turn deals no damage: attack freely. LASH turns (16): full-block with Evil Eye/Defends, no greedy damage. On the turn the parasite dies, keep block up — minions spawn; Whirlwind + Howl's 18 cl…

summary: Worms are stunned, so T1 is free: Forgotten Ritual into Howl From Beyond (18 AOE). Howl repeats every end of turn, killing all four (75 HP total). Hold the vulnerable potion for The Kin boss.
key_turns: Stunned turn 1: play Ritual then Howl; it re-fires 18 AOE at end of turn, killing all worms. Full-block the 8×N bite turn if any survive.

summary: T1 Forgotten Ritual→Howl→Stone Armor+. Howl replays 18 AOE each turn, killing both followers by T3, then all damage goes to the priest. Plating plus Unmovables carry defense; Bash+ vulnerable amplifies Howl ticks.
key_turns: Priest BEAM plus both followers ~26 incoming: full block. RITUAL turn (no attack): dump Bash+ and attacks. Frailty weakens Defends — bank block before frailty turns.

summary: Set up Inflame+/Unmovable+/Stone Armor first, then let Howl+ and AOE grind both claws down evenly; block LASER 44; only kill the last claw as both fall in one turn.
key_turns: Rocket CHARGE_UP/RECHARGE: play powers, no block needed. LASER 44 and PRECISION_BEAM 26: full block, Fortifier if short. Final turn: kill both claws together, energy potion for Whirlwind.

summary: Howl+ recurs 26 AOE every turn once played; play it turn 1, then Inflame+/Unmovable+/Stone Armor+. Burst down Magi Knight before its 35 bomb, block Flail's 21s, keep HP; Fairy only for lethal.
key_turns: Magi PREP then MAGIC_BOMB 35: kill Magi first or full-block that turn. Flail FLAIL 21: block it. Use WAR_CHANT (0 damage) and light turns for setup.

summary: Setup Demon Form+ and Inflame+ first, then Howl+ recurs 26 every turn while strength grows. Full-block the 43 Cleave, accept small chip elsewhere. Artifact 3 absorbs debuffs, so don't build around Bash/vulnerable; Fairy stays as revive.
key_turns: CHARGE 25 on T1, chip is fine; WINDUP turn: play powers and Whirlwind; HEAVY_CLEAVE 43 (T4, repeats): full block with Evil Eye+/Shrug/mass block; Swift potion only to find missing block.

summary: Setup: Demon Form+ then both Howls (they re-trigger every end of turn) and Inflame+/Unmovable+. Burst on free turns 3/6/9; defend 2/5/8; Fire Potion for lethal; kill ~T9 before withers snowball.
key_turns: T3/T6/T9 (buff turns): all-in damage. T2/T5/T8: boss 33 block + 22-36 hits — defend. T1/T4/T7 EBB: powers first, strip Artifact before Bash. Exhaust Withers with Brand+. Finish by T9.

summary: Stone Armor first, then Bash into Molten Fist for stacked vulnerable. Burning Pact eats Beckons. Block the 20/13 hits, never attack into intangible, save Flex for burst turns. Keep HP healthy for act 2.
key_turns: Turn 1 BECKON: free - play Stone Armor and attacks. DE_GAS 20 and SCREAM 13: full block. FADE: intangible, don't attack. Exhaust Beckons with Burning Pact.

summary: Turn 1 play Howl from Beyond: it re-fires 18 AOE every turn end, killing all four maws by turn 2-3. Block turn 2, avoid attacking near-dead enemies before it fires (Skittish block). Keep potions.
key_turns: T1: play Howl, take ~15. T2: block only; attacking near-dead maws before Howl re-fires gives them Skittish block and spares them. Clean up T3.

summary: Bash+ first so Unstable Lamp doubles vulnerable to 6 for the whole fight; then hit the 20-damage-per-turn cap with Dismantle/Howl, and block fully on the 18 and 15 attack turns.
key_turns: This turn 14 and T2 INERTIA (no attack, free damage turn). T3 PIERCING_STABS 18 and T4 ZOOM 15: full block. Damage capped 20/turn, so kill by turn 4-5.

summary: Slow setup fight: Bash+ first (Lamp doubles to 6 vulnerable), then Pyre and Howl from Beyond (recurring 18/turn). Block DE_GAS 20 and SCREAM 13 fully and hold HP for act 2.
key_turns: T2 DE_GAS 20 and T5 SCREAM 13: block fully; FADE turn is intangible, don't attack, play Pyre/draw/block instead; Beckon cards each deal 6 unblockable.

summary: Pyre then Rolling Boulder early; Bash+ for 6 vulnerable (Unstable Lamp), then burst with Dismantle/Perfected Strike+. Block the 21+ attack turns; hold potions for Knowledge Demon unless HP drops below ~40.
key_turns: BEES 3x7 and SPEAR 18 turns: block with Colossus+/Shrug It Off+. PHEROMONE buff turn (no damage): dump powers and attacks freely. Bash+ first for 6 vuln.

summary: Long race: Bash+ early for doubled 6 vulnerable, then both Howl copies (they re-play from exhaust each turn end) and Pyre for energy; Boulder next. Full block turns 2-3. Flex on a vulnerable burst turn.
key_turns: T2 Slap 19 and T3 Overwhelming 30: Colossus+ (needs vulnerable) plus full block. T1/T5/T9 curse turns are free: play powers. T4 Ponder heals 30.

summary: Use the free sleep turn for Inflame; then block 23-damage Slashes every turn while chipping with Bash/Headbutt; drink Regen early for the long fight, save HP for the Act 1 boss 5 floors away.
key_turns: Turn 1 asleep: Inflame, no attacks. After WAKE, every turn is Slashes 23 — fully block first, then hit; burst with Forgotten Ritual + rock to end it fast.

summary: Turn 1 set up Inflame and vulnerable, block the big PLOWs, race below 150 for the stun window and burst; Fortifier after block cards on the biggest hit turn, rock potion to force the stun or finish.
key_turns: Turn 1 free: Inflame+Bash+. Block PLOW 20/22/24. Below 150 hp boss is stunned: full attack. Ringing turn: play one best card. Beast Cry turn: attack freely.

summary: Inflame early, then Bash/Molten Fist to extend vulnerable, Bully and Twin Strike+ burst. Block the 3×7 and 18 attacks fully; rock potion for early damage (replenished each fight), Block potion on a buffed BEES turn.
key_turns: Turn 1-2 set up Inflame/Unmovable; fully block BEES 3×7 (21) and SPEAR 18; PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn = free damage; kill before strength stacks.

summary: Curse turns 1/5/9 are free: Inflame then Unmovable. Block the 19/30 attack turns; on PONDER turns out-damage the 30 heal. Bash+ into Molten Fist into Bully with Flex potion for burst; keep HP for Act 3.
key_turns: T2/T6 SLAP 19 and T3/T7 overwhelm 30: full block, Flame Barrier on the multi-hit. T4/T8 PONDER heals 30 — burst. T1/T5/T9 curse turns: powers are free.

summary: Race the bird: with tincture energy open Bash+ then Uppercut+ (vulnerable+weak), then dump attacks. Block the SWOOP turns, keep HP for the boss; skip Dark Embrace.
key_turns: Strength grows each turn (17→20+), so kill by turn 4-5; full block on SWOOP turns; refresh weak/vulnerable; never play Dark Embrace (no exhaust).

summary: Statue sleeps at start: spend it on Dark Embrace, no attacks. Wake turn is free damage. Afterwards weaken its 23 hits with Uppercut+, block fully, add chip damage; Bash into Molten Fist for a doubled-vulnerable burst. Keep HP above 50.
key_turns: Sleep turns: Dark Embrace only, no attacks. WAKE turn: dump all damage. Then each 23 Slash: Uppercut+ for weak, block first, attack with leftover energy; Molten Fist doubles vulnerable.

summary: Turn 1 is free: play Forgotten Ritual then Dark Embrace. Full-block the PLOW ramp, race to 150 for the stun, and hold potions for the biggest hits.
key_turns: Free buff turns 1-2: powers. PLOW 20-24 on T3-4: full block, get boss below 150 for the stun. RINGING turn (1 card only): biggest block. Later CRUSH 19+ needs big block.

summary: Turn 1 free: play Rupture, Inferno+, Inflame, then power potion (take Demon Form). Block the 19/30 turns; let strength scale past the 30 heal each cycle. Save vulnerable potion for a Molten Fist/Whirlwind burst turn.
key_turns: T2 slap 19, T3 overwhelm 30: full block (Shrug+, Uppercut weak). T7 overwhelm ~36 after buffs. T1/T5/T9 curse turns deal no damage - dump powers.

summary: Open Inferno+ and Stone Armor+, duplicate Bash+ for 9 vuln, then race with attacks; keep HP above steam stacks. Finish with Feed, prestock block, triple it with Fortifier for the explosion.
key_turns: T1-2 free buff turns: play powers, duplicate Bash+ (lantern = 9 vuln). Block PRESSURE_GUN 22 / STOMP 15. After kill: ABOUT_TO_BLOW turn stack block + Fortifier, no attacks; EXPLODE 40+.

summary: Play 岩石铠甲+, 狱火+, 黑暗之拥 early; plated armor trivializes BEES, block hard on SPEAR turns, dump damage on the buff turn, and finish with 狂宴 for +3 max HP. Flex potion saved for 帝皇蟹.
key_turns: BEES 3x7 mostly eaten by 6 覆甲 (keep it up); SPEAR 19-21 is the block turn (血墙/火焰屏障/耸肩); PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn = all-out damage + Bash+ for 6 vuln.

summary: Set up Inferno+, Crimson Mantle, Stone Armor on turns 1-2; block the 43 laser; Baking Glove grows strength for a long fight; keep both claws' HP even and kill both in the same turn.
key_turns: Rocket CHARGE_UP means LASER 43 next turn: full block, use Shackling. Keep claws even (hit CRUSHER more); never kill one alone; finish both in one turn.

summary: Byrdonis scales with strength every turn, so race: drop Inflame (and Juggernaut if safe) early, Bash then Molten Fist for doubled Vulnerable, full-block the 18 SWOOPs, save Blood Potion for an emergency.
key_turns: SWOOP turns (18+strength) are the big hits: block with Expect a Fight there. Bash first, then Molten Fist to double Vulnerable; finish by turn 5 before strength snowballs.

summary: Sleep turn 1: play Inflame, then Juggernaut. Wake turn buffs harmlessly, so Bash then Molten Fist for doubled vulnerable and dump attacks. Block 23+ on every SLASHES turn; Blood Potion only if HP drops under 25.
key_turns: T1-T2 free setup (it sleeps/wakes without attacking): play powers, then Bash->Molten Fist on the wake turn for 4 vulnerable. Every SLASHES turn must block 23+, Expect a Fight saved for those.

summary: Set up Inflame, Inferno, Juggernaut early; AOE down both 58/59 HP followers first (they scale), using Stomp/Inferno and Bash+Molten Fist vulnerability; then grind the 190 HP priest, blocking beam turns.
key_turns: Turn 1-2: powers (Inflame, Inferno, Juggernaut) while attacks are small. Priest's beam turn (~3 hits) plus both followers attacking is the one to block/fear; ritual turn is the free damage window.

summary: Setup Inflame then Juggernaut/Inferno; Stone Armor+ and Expect a Fight keep Juggernaut chipping. Block fully on BEES/SPEAR, all-out attack on buff turn. Brand eats Dazed for strength; Feed lands the kill. Keep HP for boss.
key_turns: SPEAR 19+ and growing BEES: full block, attack only with spare energy. PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn: play powers then all attacks. Watch Dazed buildup.

summary: Long 321 HP grind: powers up first on buff turns, then block the 29/21 hits and let Juggernaut, Inferno and AOE Breakthroughs chip the boss down. Blood potion only if HP drops low.
key_turns: LIQUIFY_GROUND/SALIVATE turns are free: play powers, no block needed. LUNGING_BITE 29 and THRASH 18/21 turns: full block with Defends/Expect a Fight. Keep sandpit above 0.

summary: 38 HP vs ~246 effective HP: grind, never race. Play Pyre, Inflame, Stone Armor+ while blocking each turn; chip with Juggernaut, Bludgeon+ on safe turns. Beetle Juice turns 1-2 to cushion low HP. Save HP for the run.
key_turns: Revive turns are free (BOOT_UP, no attack): play powers, don't waste burst. Block fully on lives 2-3 (24, then 20/16x2 at strength 6).

summary: Setup first: Pyre, Inflame, Stone Armor+. On Ebb-block/laser turns defend and play powers; on buff turns attack freely. Grind with strength, AOE and Juggernaut/Inferno; kill before boss strength snowballs.
key_turns: T2/T5/T8: boss 33 block + lasers 22/28/34 - full defense, play powers, skip attacks. T3/T6/T9 buff turns: all-out attack. Exhaust Withers with Brand. Finish before T10.

summary: Two free turns: Hellraiser first, then Bash early and Bludgeon last to exploit Slow stacks; auto-strikes ramp damage and should kill by turn 4. Fully block the 23 slashes, keep 25+ HP for the Kin boss; blood potion only if HP drops low.
key_turns: T1-2 free (Sleep/Wake): Hellraiser, then all-out. T3-4 SLASHES 23+: block to near-zero or kill first; shackling on the biggest hit.

summary: Four-turn fight: its HP loss caps at 20/turn, so set up Inflame + Unmovable, deal ~20 per turn, block the 18 stab, keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: T1 attack 14; T2 INERTIA = free turn, play powers; T3 PIERCING_STABS 18: full block, thorns here; T4 15. Cap 20 HP-loss/turn, don't overkill.

summary: Use the three sleep turns for Inflame, Unmovable, Bloodletting and never attack into her 12 plating. Burst the turn she wakes (stunned). Then keep 12+ block for the 19-21 hits and kill fast before Soul Siphon stacks.
key_turns: Turns 1-3 asleep: play powers, no attacks into 12 plating. Wake turn: stunned, burst freely. Then full-block the 19-21 hits; SOUL_SIPHON stacks -2 Str/Dex, so race before it stacks.

summary: Shell caps damage at 20/turn, so fight lasts 4+ turns: Bash for vulnerable, then Dismantle/Twin/Perfected every turn, blocking the 18 and 15 turns; hold Dexterity for the big stab.
key_turns: PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15/14 turns: block hard. INERTIA buff turn: dump all damage. Keep ≥20 dmg/turn due to shell cap.

summary: Single elite, 140 HP: play Inflame turn 1-2, Bash for vulnerable, then Twin Strike/Dismantle burst. Trigger the 70-HP stun on a CRASH turn, unload during the free turns. Regen early; Ashwater useless here.
key_turns: CRASH 23 turns: block fully. Cross 70 HP on a CRASH turn so Shriek stuns, cancelling that hit; the following STUNNED/TERROR turns are free damage.

summary: Setup while asleep: Inflame, then Bash for free vulnerable; wake her Turn 3 with Bludgeon so the wake-stun covers her attack. After that block the 20-21 hits and grind with Bash/Bludgeon - Strikes do nothing through 12 Plating.
key_turns: Turns 1-2 asleep: Inflame then Bash (no HP loss, no wake). Turn 3: Bludgeon (vulnerable + strength) wakes her, stun eats her turn. Then block SLASH 21 / DISEMBOWEL 20; SOUL_SIPHON turn is safe for se…

summary: Race: use the free INFECT turn for Howl from Beyond (18 AOE every turn), then Bash+/Molten Fist vuln burst. Block the 16-damage LASH turns. AOE the death spawns; hold block potion unless HP dips.
key_turns: T1 INFECT is free: play Howl. LASH 16 turns: block it or trade only if lethal next turn. After death, AOE the spawned frogs; don't attack the corpse.

summary: Race with AOE: use the free stunned turn for Howl from Beyond, wiping two wrigglers and nearly killing the rest; finish leftovers next turn before their 8-damage bites land. Save block potion unless HP drops low.
key_turns: T1 all four are stunned and free: Howl from Beyond (18 to all) kills two and leaves two at 2-3 HP. T2 finish them with Thunderclap/Strikes. Only fear bite turns (8 each) if more than one survives.

summary: Turn 1 while it sleeps, play Howl from Beyond so it re-fires 18/turn for free; then block the 23-damage Slashes and concentrate attacks in single turns for Slow. Block potion only if a slash is uncovered and HP drops.
key_turns: Wake turn (no attack) is free damage. After that, Slashes hit 23 every turn — cover with Blood Wall+Defend; concentrate attacks in one turn to stack Slow.

summary: Race with AOE: Howl from Beyond+ and Inferno on turn 1-2, then wipe both 58 HP followers with recurring 24 AOE plus Thunderclap; block potion for the ~26-incoming turn, then grind priest's 190 HP.
key_turns: T1-2 followers buff freely: play Howl+ (24 AOE recurring from exhaust) and Inferno. Kill both followers before their POWER_DANCE stack grows. Block hard on priest BEAM/debuff turn plus both attackers…

summary: Open with Inflame, Inferno, Brand while blocking; drink both potions early. Then Bash+ -> Molten Fist -> Dominate for massive strength; Expect a Fight blocks big turns. Kill within ~7 turns before PULSATE buffs stack.
key_turns: PULSATE (8+buff) is the safe turn for powers/full attack. Fully block JAB and WHIRLWIND (~15+ and climbing); never fall under ~15 HP in the last cycles.

summary: Set up Inflame, Inferno, Brand early while blocking. Chip both crabs with AOE, block the 43 laser, keep their HP even, then finish both the same turn; attack potion for that burst.
key_turns: Rocket's LASER 43 after CHARGE_UP: full block. Never leave one crab low; Inferno's 6 chip can trigger rage — kill both in one turn.

summary: Use the two free turns to set up Rupture and Bash. Block each 23 Slash with Blood Wall (also feeds Rupture strength) and Defends. Play cheap cards first, Whirlwind last for Slow; strength potion early.
key_turns: T1 Sleep, T2 Wake: no damage, play Rupture then Bash. T3-T4 Slashes 23+: Blood Wall plus Defends; Beetle Juice on T3; Bash before the Whirlwind burst.

summary: Race the 63 HP body before status cards pile up: attack on free INFECT turns, fully block LASH 16 turns, Bash then Rupture turn 1. Save Whirlwind for the 4 spawns on death, then burst them all.
key_turns: INFECT turns do 0 damage: Bash + full attack, drop Rupture. LASH 16 turns: Blood Wall or 3 Defends, Parry Shield chips. When body dies, Whirlwind the 4 spawns immediately.

summary: Race the spawned wrigglers: free stun turn = full Whirlwind for 15 each, then kill the 3-6 HP leftovers with Strikes/Anger/Headbutt. No Rupture setup, no potions; block the last 8-damage bites.
key_turns: Now: all four stunned, free turn — spend all 3 energy on Whirlwind (15 to all, leaves 3-6 HP). Next turns each survivor bites for 8: finish the lowest-HP ones first, block rest.

summary: Play Demon Form+ then Rupture in the first two turns; strip Slippery with multi-hit attacks, block heavily on DISMEMBER turns, and cash Vulnerable potion once strength is high. Full HP means take the scaling line.
key_turns: DISMEMBER 27 (+3 wounds) turn: full block via Flame Barrier/Blood Wall/Shrug It Off. PREPARE is the free buff/damage turn. Strip 8 Slippery with Whirlwind/Anger before big hits.

summary: Setup Demon Form+ and Rupture, full-block the 21/19 attacks, burst on the free buff turn and kill fast; keep HP for the Act 2 boss.
key_turns: T1: Demon Form+ through BEES 21. T2/T4 (19/21): full-block with Flame Barrier + Shrug It Off. T3 buff turn is free: Rupture + Whirlwind, then finish by T5-6.

summary: Set up Demon Form+ and Rupture in the first two turns, then race: block every LUNGING_BITE (~29), let strength snowball, use Fortifier on the biggest hit turn, clear 狂乱逃离 when the sandpit runs low.
key_turns: T1 no attack: Demon Form+, then Rupture. LUNGING_BITE ~29 is the big-hit turn: full block or Fortifier. When sandpit ≤2, play 狂乱逃离 first, then attack.

summary: Play Demon Form+ and Rupture early while blocking every big hit; three lives (~247 HP, +3 str each) means ramp slowly, never trade HP for damage, and burst once strength is high.
key_turns: T1 take 14: play Demon Form+ then block; ONE_TWO turns full block; BOOT_UP revive turns are free (no attack) — use them; hits grow +3 str per life.

summary: Race the bird: Bash+ vulnerable turn 1, then unload Pommel Strikes and Whirlwind every turn until dead. No powers to set up; Flex potion pairs with Whirlwind for the finishing burst.
key_turns: T1-2 land Bash+ then dump all attacks; Peck 15 / Swoop 18 grow +strength each turn, so kill by T4-5; drink Flex on a Whirlwind turn, Swift only if hand lacks Bash.

summary: Race the parasite: on its free infect turn play Forgotten Ritual then Bash+ for vulnerable, block its 16-damage lashes, and hold Whirlwind+ to sweep the spawns it leaves on death. Preserve HP for The Kin boss.
key_turns: StatusCard/infect turns deal 0 — play Ritual and Bash+. Block the LASH 16 turns fully (Evil Eye + Shrug). When the parasite dies, spawns appear: have Whirlwind+ ready that turn.

summary: All four wrigglers are stunned and at 8–12 HP: race them down now — Whirlwind+ at 2 energy wipes all four this turn. Otherwise set up Forgotten Ritual, kill high-HP ones, save speed potion for The Kin boss.
key_turns: T1 all stunned: no block, dump damage; Whirlwind+ (2 energy) kills all four. Surviving bites 8 each next turn — block with Evil Eye/Shrug, then finish.

summary: Race the followers down first (they scale): Whirlwind+ both, Bash+ the focus target, attack freely on RITUAL turns. Save block for BEAM and frail turns, Speed potion when one turn's damage exceeds block.
key_turns: Priest RITUAL turn 2 is free damage; followers buff every 3rd turn — kill one follower fast. Frail turn ~T3: block hard, Evil Eye after an exhaust.

summary: Race: turn 1 Bash+ for vulnerable, then dump all Hot Cocoa energy into Whirlwind+ (8/hit x1.5, mini-cannon boosted); Setup Strike first for +3/hit. Kill by turn 4-5 before strength stacks.
key_turns: Full-block turns: JAB 15 and WHIRLWIND 15 (Shrug/Evil Eye/Taunt+Defends); PULSATE 8+buff turn: attack through it; end turns with 10+ block for Parry Shield chip.

summary: Sulfur gives us +1 str/turn and them +1, so race: AOE (Whirlwind+/Stomp+) with Bash+ vulnerable. Keep both claws' HP balanced and finish both in one turn; block LASER and BUG_STING turns. Speed potion for the 43 laser.
key_turns: Rocket CHARGE_UP: go all-in attack/AOE. LASER 43 turn: full block or Speed potion. Keep claw HP even; kill both same turn — survivor gains 99 block +6 str.

summary: Race each of its 3 lives: kill in ~3 turns before Sulfur-stacked attacks outscale us; block only real threats, keep HP for the boss run; use the two BOOT_UP turns to set up, dexterity potion on life 3's big attack.
key_turns: BOOT_UP turns are free (no attack, it gains 10 block): play accelerators, set up burst. Life 3 HAMMER_UPPERCUT/ONE_TWO ~40-50 from Sulfur stacks — full block plus dexterity potion.

summary: Race: Bash+/Dismantle+ the Flail Knight first, chip all three with Whirlwind+/Stomp+, then Magi, then Spectral. Block the T5 bomb; Sulfur punishes dragging this out.
key_turns: T5 Magi MAGIC_BOMB ~40: pre-block with Flame Barrier+/Blood Wall/Evil Eye. Kill Flail by ~T4 (FLAIL 20 + WAR_CHANT scales fastest); Sulfur adds +1 enemy STR/turn, so end it by ~T7.

summary: T1 EBB is setup: Inflame+, block, no attacks into 33 block. Strip Artifact 3 with Bash+/Taunt+. Big energy-stacked Whirlwind+ burst on INTENSITY turns; full-block EYE_LASERS. Kill by turn 8-9.
key_turns: EBB (1/4/7): 33 block, setup/block, skip attacks. EYE_LASERS (2/5/8): full block. INTENSITY (3/6/9): no enemy attack — dump Whirlwind+/Stomp+ burst, keep some block for Wither.

summary: Race the 61 HP parasite down with Bash-vulnerable + Dismantle/Hemokinesis, block the 16 LASH turns, hold Whirlwind for the four spawns after it dies; thorns potion once spawns attack.
key_turns: T2/T4 LASH 16 — block fully (Flame Barrier); INFECT turns are free: Bash then Dismantle. Keep Whirlwind for the 4 spawns after it dies.

summary: Race: no powers. Kill lowest-HP Wrigglers one per turn (Bash+Dismantle 32, Hemokinesis+Strike 21). Block the synchronized 4x8 bite turns; free WRIGGLE turns go full damage/Whirlwind. Keep ~40 HP for Vantom.
key_turns: T2 all four NASTY_BITE 8 = 32: kill 1+ now and block with Flame Barrier (thorns hit all) + Shrug. WRIGGLE turns (0 damage) are free: full attack, Whirlwind.

summary: No powers to set up; it starts asleep, so early turns are free. Then Slashes 22 every turn: play skills first and biggest attack last (Slow), Bash into Dismantle+Hemokinesis, block with leftover energy, finish within ~4 attack turns.
key_turns: Sleep/WAKE turns are free: no block needed, just cycle. From the first SLASHES (22), spend leftover energy on Shrug/Defends; Bash sets vulnerable, next turn Dismantle+Hemokinesis burst.

summary: No powers, so race: strip 8 Slippery with cheap multi-hits (Boomerang/Twirl/Anger), apply vuln+weak, then dump Whirlwind; full-block INKY_LANCE and DISMEMBER 27, burst on PREPARE.
key_turns: Cheap multi-hits strip Slippery; next turn INKY_LANCE two hits, block both; then every 4th turn DISMEMBER 27+3 wounds — full block; PREPARE turn is free burst.

summary: Race Entomancer: Inflame and Stone Armor down early; Flame Barrier+ on the 3×7 BEES turns, Impervious only when block is short; use the PHEROMONE_SPIT free turn for full attacks; keep both potions for Kaiser Crab.
key_turns: T1 BEES 3×7: Flame Barrier+ (3 retaliations); SPEAR turn: real block, Impervious if short; PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn: free — full attacks/powers. Prefer big single hits; extra Daze from multi-hit.

summary: Play Demon Form/Inflame/Stone Armor early. Block the 43 laser and 20+ hits; HP is for the run. Keep both claws' HP even and finish both in one turn — never kill one alone (+99 block, +6 str).
key_turns: Rocket's LASER 43 after CHARGE_UP: full block (Flame Barrier+/Impervious). Crusher's 20-22 hits need real block. Kill both claws same turn; keep HP even.

summary: Demon Form+ turn 1, then Inflame/Stone Armor; block the 36-hit turns fully and kill with strength-boosted multi-hits. Full HP elite — save the serum potion for Queen.
key_turns: T1 take 29 to land Demon Form+; fully block the 36 Maelstrom/Soul Burn turns with Impervious/Flame Barrier+; then ramp and burst with Whirlwind/Conflagration before Drain Life heals it.

summary: Single 300 HP elite, 3 artifact eats debuffs so skip Vulnerable lines. Turn 1 Demon Form+, then Inflame/Stone Armor; scale with Baking Glove, bank block for Cleave, keep HP for Queen.
key_turns: Windup turn: no attack, so play powers/attacks freely. HEAVY_CLEAVE 42 turn: hold Impervious + Flame Barrier+; Stable Serum retains block cards across it.

summary: Powers up turns 1-2 (Queen passive, no block); AOE both. Then kill the Amalgam while the Queen only blocks/buffs; afterwards block her big hits and race. One chained card per turn.
key_turns: T1-2 no debuff: powers + AOE on both, block the tackles. T3+ Queen blocks 20: focus Amalgam. Then block OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD 7x5 / EXECUTION and weaken her with Uppercut.

summary: Race: Bash then Molten Fist on one Gardener (vulnerable doubled), focus kills one at a time, buffer first. Skittish blocks only hits after the first per enemy, so lead with your hardest hit.
key_turns: Kill the Enlarge buffer first — its buffs raise all attacks. Block 18+ incoming turns (LASH+FLAIL stacked); otherwise all-in on one kill; start each turn with your biggest hit.

summary: Bash then Molten Fist for 4 Vulnerable, Uppercut for Weak, then grind exactly 20 damage per turn while blocking the 18/15 hits; potions only if HP drops.
key_turns: T3 PIERCING_STABS 18 and T4 15 are the hits to pre-block; T2 is INERTIA 9+buff. Cap 20 damage each turn; excess is wasted, so bank spare energy in block.

summary: Turn 1 Beckon is free: play Feel No Pain, then Uppercut/Bash. Race 211 HP with Bash→Molten Fist vulnerable and Bludgeon; exhaust Beckons with True Grit, block DE_GAS 20 and Scream 13, hold HP for Act 2.
key_turns: DE_GAS 20: full block. FADE/intangible: no attacks — play powers, True Grit away Beckons. SCREAM 13 and Beckon turns: block; each Beckon costs 6 unblockable.

summary: Turn 1 Inflame plus Power Potion hoping for Demon Form, stay passive while it sleeps, block up on the last sleep turn. Then Bash+ into Molten Fist+ into Bully/Dismantle vulnerable burst, always blocking the 19-21 hits.
key_turns: Sleep T1-3: play no attacks and no Howl (damage wakes it); stack block on T3. After it wakes (21/19 hits): full block on attack turns, burst on SOUL_SIPHON/buff turns.

summary: No attacks turns 1-2 — any HP loss wakes the boss early. Turn 3 burst (wake-stun is free then): Bash+ first, then Molten Fist/Hemokinesis. Then race with vuln combos while blocking its 21/21/9×2 cycle; use both potions this fight.
key_turns: T1-2: no attacks (wakes it). T3: burst, Bash+ then Molten Fist (vuln 3→6). After: block 21/21 and 9×2 with Flame Barrier+; SOUL_SIPHON turn is free damage.

summary: Set up turn 1 with Hot Cocoa's 7 energy: Hellraiser plus Bash+/Molten Fist/Dominate stack vuln and strength, then kill fast with big single hits (15-17) to limit Dazed. Flame Barrier+ every BEES turn; save HP for boss.
key_turns: T1 (7 energy): Fysh Oil, Hellraiser, Bash+→Molten Fist→Dominate (vuln 6, +7 str). Block BEES with Flame Barrier+ (retaliation); free damage on spit turn. Few big hits only — Dazed per hit.

summary: Keep all three segments at near-equal HP; killing one alone just reattaches it at 25. Set up Hellraiser and vuln-strength (Bash+, Dominate), block the big WRITHE hits, then finish every segment in one turn with Thunderclap+ plus Explosive …
key_turns: T1-2 ~24 incoming: block the WRITHE 12-13 / CONSTRICT 9 hits, spread damage via Flame Barrier+/thorns. Burst turn: all three at ~15 HP or less, Thunderclap+ then Explosive Ampoule kills all before an…

summary: Turns 1-2 setup: Hellraiser, Unmovable+, Bash+; then Molten Fist doubles vulnerable and Dominate converts it to +4-7 permanent Strength. Afterwards block the 29/21 bites and grind the 321 HP while Hellraiser free-plays Strikes.
key_turns: Turn 1 (LIQUIFY_GROUND, no attack) and SALIVATE turns: play powers/attack freely. LUNGING_BITE 29 and THRASH 18-21: full block, biggest block card first (Unmovable+ doubles it). Sandpit <=2: Frantic …

summary: Inferno early for 6 free damage/turn. Enemy caps at 20 HP lost per turn: chip ~20 each turn while blocking its 14–18 attacks. INERTIA turn is free setup. Flex saved for boss; Blood potion emergency only.
key_turns: Next turn INERTIA buff is free: play powers/attacks. Then PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15 — block fully. Enemy loses max 20 HP/turn; deal ~20 while blocking the 14–18 hits.

summary: Long fight: powers first, grow Inferno chip (Hemokinesis triggers it), block big De Gas/Scream turns, waste nothing while faded, exhaust Beckon curses, heal potion only if HP drops low.
key_turns: T1 Beckon: free setup — Inferno, Feel No Pain, Power Potion. FADE/intangible turns: no attacks, block and powers only. DE_GAS ~15 and SCREAM 13: full block. Exhaust Beckons via Second Wind/True Grit.

summary: Turn 1: Rupture+, Breakthrough, Howl, then let Howl's free AOE plus Bash+/Bully finish the lowest-HP or buffing gardener each turn; Strength potion immediately; keep incoming 15-20 blocked.
key_turns: Turns 1-2: Rupture+, Breakthrough, then Howl (it re-fires from exhaust every turn, so strength multiplies x4). Skittish 6 resets on the enemy turn: lead each target with the biggest hit. Kill the ENL…

summary: Setup fight: play Rupture+ turn 1, ramp strength with Breakthrough self-damage, play Howl early for free 18/turn; exhaust Beckons; block DE_GAS 20 and SCREAM 13 fully. Keep HP high for act 2.
key_turns: T2 DE_GAS 20 and T5 SCREAM 13: block fully; T4 FADE (intangible): no attacks, play Howl from Beyond; on BECKON turns exhaust Beckon cards with Burning Pact/True Grit.

summary: Play Inflame+ turn 1 with Lantern, then Bash+ for vulnerable and race with Strikes/Pommel. Block the SWOOP turns; Fortifier on a big hit; finish by turn 4-5 before strength snowballs.
key_turns: Turns 2-4: SWOOP hits 18-22 and grow +1/turn; keep block up, drink Fortifier after Defends on the ≥22 turn; kill before turn 5.

summary: Turn 1: Inflame+ on Lantern energy, Bash+ left follower. Focus followers one at a time (Thunderclap AOE), using True Grit/Toric for Beam turns. Then grind priest with strength and vulnerable.
key_turns: Priest BEAM ~20 and ORB_OF_FRAILTY (frail cuts block) are the spike; RITUAL turn is free — attack. Kill both followers before they finish dancing (strength scaling).

summary: Powers fuel the damage race: Pyre+, Inflame+, Inferno on turn 1. Then attack every turn, block only the 18-29 hits; play escape cards whenever sandpit drops low.
key_turns: T1 buff turn: free setup. THRASH 18, LUNGING_BITE 29, THRASH_MOVE_2 21 need full block. SALIVATE/buff turns: dump all damage. Sandpit low: play escape cards first.

summary: T1-2: Pyre+ first (Throwing Axe doubles it), Inflame+, Inferno, but keep blocking with leftover energy. Then Crimson Mantle/Stone Armor/Juggernaut plus AOE; single-target goes to Magi Knight. Stay above 25 HP.
key_turns: T2 ~30 incoming; T4 Flail 20; T5 Magi's 35 bomb plus ~24 more = ~59. Magi must die by T4, else Beetle Juice plus full block.

summary: T1-2 powers: Pyre+ (axe-doubled), Inflame+, Inferno; then Crimson Mantle/Stone Armor/Toric block grind, chip with Inferno+Juggernaut+Breakthrough, burst on BOOT_UP turns. Keep HP for Queen.
key_turns: BOOT_UP after each kill: no attack — dump attacks/powers. Fully block ONE_TWO (24→32) and HAMMER_UPPERCUT turns; drink weak potion on ONE_TWO if HP<35.

summary: Use the two debuff-free turns for Pyre+, Inflame+, Inferno (Throwing Axe doubles Pyre+), then pour all damage into the 199 HP Amalgam while blocking its 25+ hits. Once it dies, Queen enrages — turtle through her 46+ bursts; foul potions st…
key_turns: T1 Amalgam hits 26 — partial block, play Pyre+/Inflame+/Inferno. T2 you get 99 vuln/weak: bank block. The turn after Amalgam dies, Queen bursts ~46 — full block, stay above 35 HP.

summary: Race, no powers to set up. Bash for vulnerable on a target that survives 2+ hits; strikes delete the lowest-HP Wriggler first. Energy Potion in turns 1-2 for a burst double-kill; otherwise take small hits rather than slow the race.
key_turns: Kill order: 17→19→20→21 HP Wrigglers. Block only when 3+ attack (incoming >16); Wriggle buffs stack, so finish by turn 5-6.

summary: Race the elite: Bash+ then Molten Fist doubles vulnerable to 6. Hold Whirlwind+ and the Flex potion for the phrogs that spawn on death. Block the 16 lashes; enter the Kin boss with high HP.
key_turns: LASH 16: block fully. INFECT turn: play attacks, Burning Pact clears a status. Kill turn: Setup Strike+ then Whirlwind+ with Flex potion to sweep the spawned phrogs.

summary: Race: all four wrigglers are stunned, so one Whirlwind+ turn (24 to all) ends the fight at zero risk. Don't spend energy on Bash or Molten Fist first. Enter the Kin boss near full HP.
key_turns: All four are stunned now: Whirlwind+ with 3 energy, or Setup Strike+ then Whirlwind+ with 2, deals 24 to all and wipes them. If survivors, next turn bites 8 each — full block.

summary: Race: Pyre turn 1 for energy, Bash+ vulnerable, then Setup Strike+ + Whirlwind+ burst; kill by turn 3-4 before strength snowballs; keep blocking, save HP for boss.
key_turns: Enemy gains +1 strength every turn (17→19→21): kill by T3-4. T1 Pyre+Defend; apply Bash+ vulnerable first, then Setup Strike+ with Whirlwind+; block each turn.

summary: Turn 1 Pyre for energy; Bash+ vulnerable, Setup Strike+ into Whirlwind+ to clear both followers; then race the 190 HP priest, strength potion on the biggest Whirlwind turn.
key_turns: Power Dance buffs and priest RITUAL are free-damage turns; kill both followers by ~turn 4 with Bash+ then Whirlwind+; pre-block BEAM 12 and the multi-orb turns once followers die.

summary: Play Pyre/Inflame/Forgotten Ritual/Inferno early, build strength, spread damage evenly across all three segments, then kill all three in one Whirlwind burst turn while blocking the spike turns.
key_turns: WRITHE/CONSTRICT turns bring ~25-30; block hard and drink weak potion then. Never kill one segment alone: it revives at 25 HP.

summary: Play Pyre/Inflame/Forgotten Ritual turn 1-2, chip both claws evenly with Whirlwind/Breakthrough/Inferno, block the 43 laser, then burst both claws dead in the same turn; Fysh Oil on the kill turn.
key_turns: Rocket's CHARGE_UP then LASER 43 and PRECISION_BEAM 26: full block or dex potion. Fear every turn one claw sits at near-zero while the other is healthy (99 block +6 str).

summary: Turns 1-2 play Pyre+, Inflame, Inferno; then Whirlwind+ with strength for AOE burst. Focus Magi, then Flail; block each attack turn, stay above 50 HP for the boss.
key_turns: MAGIC_BOMB 35 ~turn 5: kill Magi before it or full block; FLAIL 20 and SOUL_SLASH 15: block hard; play powers on light turns.

summary: Set up Pyre+, Inflame, Stone Armor+ in the first turns and BOOT_UP windows; grind all 3 lives with strength-boosted attacks/Whirlwind; block HAMMER and ONE_TWO fully; preserve HP for the Test Subject boss.
key_turns: ONE_TWO 12×2 and HAMMER turns: full block (Flame Barrier/Thorns shine). After each life's kill, BOOT_UP turn — play powers/block, don't attack into 10 block. Strength +3 each life.

summary: Turn 1-2: Pyre+, Inflame, Inferno (powers don't trigger Enrage); drink Power Potion. Phase 1 burst 100 with attacks only. Enter phase 2 ≥60 HP and race; phase 3 chip, keep 40 HP.
key_turns: Fear BIG_POUNCE and phase-2 MULTI_CLAW ramping 30→60: full block or race to kill. Respawn turns are free — exhaust wounds, play powers. Phase 3: keep ≥40 HP.

summary: Play Inferno turn 1, then Bash and Molten Fist to stack vulnerable. Deal steady damage under its 20/turn HP-loss cap while blocking the 14-18 attacks. Skill potion early for block; swift potion only when HP drops.
key_turns: No-attack INERTIA turn: play powers and attack freely. Fully block PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15/14 spikes; its cycle-2 damage comes back higher, so kill before then.

summary: Turn 1 Inferno, then Breakthrough each turn: 15 AOE to all four. Focus lowest-HP gardener, lead with Hatchet, then Bash+Molten Fist. Block turns when incoming is high. Save potions for Soul Fysh boss.
key_turns: ENLARGE/buff turns: no damage, attack freely. Turns with 2+ LASH 8 or FLAIL multi-hit: full block. After buffs hits grow — kill the buffed gardener first.

summary: T1 free turn: drink Power Potion, play Inferno then Unmovable. Inferno plus Breakthrough bleed ~21 AOE/turn while blocking the 20/13 hits and cleaning Beckons; don't attack during FADE; save Blood Potion for a near-death turn.
key_turns: T2 DE_GAS 20 and T7: full block via Unmovable-boosted Evil Eye, no greed. T4 FADE intangible: play only powers/skills/blocks, never attacks. T6 Beckon-free: burst. Land Feed for the kill.

summary: Setup Rupture+Inferno T1-2 (free Power Potion), add Unmovable early; every turn self-damage (Hemokinesis/Breakthrough) feeds Inferno AOE and Rupture Strength; aim single-target at highest-HP segment, wipe all three in one turn.
key_turns: Turns 4-6: WRITHE cycle, ~40+ incoming as Strength stacks; full-block with doubled Evil Eye/Taunt and serum; only kill a segment when all three die same turn.

summary: Rupture then Inferno, Unmovable by T2; block 19/30, develop on curse turns, out-damage Ponder's 30 heal. No potions; 42 HP is the budget.
key_turns: T2 Slap 19, T3 Knowledge Overwhelming 30: full block, use Unmovable. T1/T5/T9 free: play powers. T4 Ponder heals 30 — keep damage ahead.

summary: No powers, so race the 140 HP eel. Bash, then vulnerable Bludgeon/Unrelenting to cross 70 for the free stun+TERROR turns and spend them attacking. Strength potion turn 1-2, Swift on the burst turn; block its CRASH turns.
key_turns: Bash now; T2 Bludgeon into vulnerable crosses 70: its attack is cancelled and TERROR gives another free turn. Block fully for the CRASH 23 after TERROR.

summary: Race, no powers needed: Bludgeon one-shots a gardener turn 1, then kill one per turn, biggest attack first — never split damage past Skittish block. Reach the boss with HP buffer.
key_turns: Skittish: block lands after the first attack card — lead with the biggest hit. 3-attacker turns (~20 dmg): True Grit+Evil Eye for 16 block. ENLARGE turns (0 dmg): attack freely.

summary: Race: explosion = 15+3 per turn at kill, so finish by ~turn 10. Turn 1 Rupture (free turn), Bash for vuln, Unrelenting+ into free Bludgeon. Block the 22; keep HP ≥ 35 for the explosion.
key_turns: PRESSURE_GUN 22 turn: block fully. Wreck phase: attacks are useless — no attacking, stack block; weak potion, then block heavily on the EXPLODE turn.

summary: Demon Form turn 1. Focus one Gardener at a time, lowest HP first; lead each turn's attacks with the biggest hit (Skittish block triggers after). Block the ~20-damage turns with Expect a Fight; Stomp when multiple are low.
key_turns: T1: Demon Form, eat 15 (HP 80 fine). Turns with 3-4 attackers (~20 dmg): Expect a Fight/Defends. Kill lowest HP first, biggest hit first (Skittish), Stomp once 2+ are low.

summary: Set up Demon Form turn 1 on its free Buff turn, then race it down so steam stacks stay small; hold HP above the stack count, fully block the EXPLODE turn, and save Clarity for that block turn.
key_turns: Turn 1 is a no-damage Buff turn: play Demon Form (plus Power Potion). Kill it fast so eruption stacks stay low; keep HP above stack count; on the ABOUT_TO_BLOW/EXPLODE turn dump every block card for …

summary: Demon Form turn 1 (Offering to pay for it if needed), Inflame soon. Scale strength: block big hits with Expect a Fight, burst with Unrelenting into free Clash/Ultimate Strike; finish before damage snowballs.
key_turns: PULSATE is its buff turn — free hit, dump attacks. On WHIRLWIND and post-PULSATE JAB/RADIATE use Expect a Fight (5×str) and Taunt+ vuln, then Unrelenting burst. Never fall below ~25 HP.

summary: Turn 1-2: Offering into Demon Form, second Inflame free via Power Potion, race strength. Whittle both claws evenly (Rocket first, its 43 laser is the kill threat), block the 43, then finish both in a single turn.
key_turns: Rocket CHARGE_UP then LASER ~43: full block + Power Potion turn 1-2 to ramp Demon Form; once claws under ~40 HP each, burst both in one turn — never kill one alone (other gets 99 block +6 str).

summary: Play Demon Form, Inflame, Pyre early; block with 钗 plus Defends/Expect a Fight; grind all three lives (76/80/95), spending vulnerable potion on a burst turn.
key_turns: After each kill AXEBOT uses BOOT_UP (10 block, +3 strength, no attack) — free setup turns. Post-revival hits harder: 16–20 solo, 16x2 plus weak/frail on third life; keep 20+ block up.

summary: Racing 234 HP from 44 is impossible: ramp Demon Form + Inflame/Pyre while blocking big hits with 钗 and Defend+/Taunt+. Inferno+ turns Hemokinesis/Dismantle/Offering into burst. Liquid Memories is the safety net; kill before the 21-35 cycle…
key_turns: MAELSTROM 31 / SOUL_BURN 35 turns: full block (钗, Defend+ x2, Taunt+, Expect a Fight). After its vulnerable lands treat every 21+ hit as ~30; never end a turn under 25 HP.

summary: Spring the free turn 1: play Inferno, drink Strength and Power potions. Block De Gas/Scream, attack on Gaze/Beckon turns, skip attacks while intangible; grind 211 HP and keep HP for act 2.
key_turns: T2 De Gas 20 and T5 Scream 13: full block. T4 Fade = intangible, no attacks. Exhaust Beckons with Second Wind+; Fiend Fire burst on a safe, non-intangible turn.

summary: Vuln race: Bash then Molten Fist same turn for 4 vuln, then Bully/Dismantle burst. Block the 15s, Inferno on a low-damage turn. Expect ~30 HP loss; keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: Attack turns JAB 15/RADIATE 11/WHIRLWIND 15: full block. PULSATE (8+buff): play Inferno, dump damage. Kill by ~turn 6 before buffs stack; keep Fiend Fire for the lethal turn.

summary: Race the 321 HP boss: Inferno early, Bash then Molten Fist for 4 vulnerable, burst with Dismantle/Bully/Fiend Fire. Spend both potions this fight; only block the 29 bite and strengthened THRASH turns.
key_turns: Turn 1 is free: Inferno, Bash, Bloodletting. Full-block LUNGING_BITE 29 (Shackling if short). Growing THRASH 21+ needs block. After StatusCard-6, clear hand via Fiend Fire/Second Wind; keep sandpit a…

summary: Unmovable turn 1, then 16-block Evil Eye each turn. Taunt/Bash for vulnerable, Breakthrough (9 to all four). Kill lowest-HP eel one at a time; Barricade once first kill lands and HP≥45; ampoule early; save HP for Soul Fysh.
key_turns: ~15 incoming (3+5+7) every turn and grows after ENLARGE; keep ≥16 block with Unmovable+Evil Eye first. Barricade on T3-4 after the first kill; if hand is all Strikes, Skill Potion for block.

summary: Fortress setup: Barricade on a 0-damage turn (T1 BECKON), then Unmovable and stack block; never attack into FADE intangible; punish GAZE/BECKON turns; vuln potion on a burst turn.
key_turns: T2/T7 DE_GAS 20: full block, Molten Fist then Evil Eye = 32. FADE: no attacks, bank block/play powers. BECKON: free turn for Barricade, ~12 chip to tank.

summary: Defend everything: at 9 HP any unblocked hit kills. Drink Regen turn 1, Weak early. Keep Prism vulnerable and Colossus its attacks; Unmovable online ASAP, Barricade only on the buff turn. Kill slowly.
key_turns: Full block every attack turn: Taunt/Uppercut keep it vulnerable, Colossus halves JAB 15, RADIATE, WHIRLWIND 15. Only the PULSATE buff turn is safe for Barricade/Unmovable.

summary: Race: Bash+/Molten Fist vulnerable chain with Twin Strike and Bully, drop it under 70 to trigger the stun, block only on CRASH turns. Keep HP for the act boss.
key_turns: Burst below 70 HP early: crossing it stuns and cancels that turn's attack. Block the CRASH 23 (capped at 20) turns; TERROR turn is free damage.

summary: Race: wake her immediately (T1) with Bash+ to Molten Fist to Bully vuln chain, keep Bully rolling every turn, skip Rupture (no self-damage), drink Strength potion early, block only to survive.
key_turns: Wake stun is free; DISEMBOWEL 21 and SLASH 21 are the scary turns, SLASH2 9x2. SOUL_SIPHON = free all-in attack turn. Relic caps loss at 20/turn; block only when HP<45.

summary: Rupture turn 1 (even paying a few HP), then Offering for strength/energy, Bash+ into Molten Fist (vuln 6) and Bully; block the 15s and race 161 HP before VITAL_SPARK stacks.
key_turns: Buffed JAB (17+) and WHIRLWIND multi-hit are the feared turns: full block, Weak potion. Kill by ~T6 before its buffs stack; T1 Rupture.

summary: Rupture then Offering/Bloodletting for strength; block the 42 laser; keep both claws balanced; same-turn double kill with buffed Stomp/Howl; avoid extra HP loss since act 3 follows.
key_turns: Rocket CHARGE_UP then LASER 42: full block that turn. Keep both claws' HP near-equal; finish both in one turn with Stomp/Howl (Goblin Horn chains energy).

summary: Two free turns to front-load Bash, Hemokinesis+, Setup Strike+ into Whirlwind+. Then block ~18+ on each 23-damage turn and kill within 3-4 more turns; 79 HP is plenty.
key_turns: T1 Sleep and T2 Wake deal no damage: dump everything, Bash+ 易伤 first. From T3 SLASHES 23 every turn: block with Shrug/Defends while finishing; play many cards in one turn for Slow.

summary: Use the no-attack INFECT turn for Inflame + Battle Trance, then race the 61 HP parasite with Bash+/Hemokinesis+/Dismantle; save AOE for the death spawn, block LASH 16, potion only if low.
key_turns: INFECT turns are free: play Inflame/Battle Trance, then attack. Fully block LASH 16. On the kill turn hold Whirlwind+/Breakthrough for the spawned adds.

summary: Parasite is dead; four Wrigglers just spawned stunned. Use the free turns: Inflame first, then Whirlwind+/Breakthrough with Setup Strike+ strength to sweep all 17-21 HP adds. Finish survivors before they can bite; potion emergency only.
key_turns: Two free turns (stunned, no incoming). Then each survivor bites 8 (up to 32). AOE them down before that; Block Potion only if 24+ incoming at low HP.

summary: Play Inflame early while incoming is small, use AOE (Howl replays 18, Breakthrough, Whirlwind+) to clear both growing followers first, then grind priest with Bash+/Dismantle/Hemokinesis+ behind Shrug It Off; potions only when needed.
key_turns: Turns 1-2 are light (<=13): play Inflame, then Howl from Beyond + Breakthrough/Whirlwind+ to kill both followers by turn 3-5. Block BEAM 12 turns; priest RITUAL is a free damage turn.

summary: Block ~24/turn while landing 燃烧 and 狱火; every self-damage (御血术, 放血, 突破) triggers 6 AOE to all. Level the three segments, then finish all in one turn with 旋风斩+ plus AoE. Regen now; block potion only for an uncoverable turn.
key_turns: T1 incoming 24: full block. Debuff/constrict turns hurt most; keep all three segments' HP level (~25-30), then one Whirlwind+ burst kills all. Howl recurs from exhaust: play early.

summary: Setup Demon Form, Inferno, Inflame in first turns; block ~20/turn meanwhile. Chip both claws evenly via AoE (Inferno self-damage triggers), never let one fall behind. Save both potions for the synchronized kill turn.
key_turns: Rocket's CHARGE_UP then LASER 42: block it fully. Never kill one claw alone (rage: 99 block, +6 str). Keep HPs within ~10; finish both in one turn with Whirlwind+/potions.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Demon Form, Inflame, Inferno, Stone Armor/Crimson Mantle while boss block is up. Then block each attack, let strength and self-damage AOE snowball, burst with Whirlwind/Howl by turn 10.
key_turns: EBB 22 and EYE_LASERS turns: block fully. After EBB's 33 block, only powers/skills. INCREASING_INTENSITY: dump attacks; keep block for Wither chip. Kill by turn ~10.

summary: Long grind: hardened shell caps damage per turn, so play Stone Armor early, then Bash into Molten Fist while blocking the 14-18 attack turns every cycle; keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: INERTIA is a free turn: play Stone Armor and attack freely; fully block PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15; per-turn HP loss is capped ~20, so spread damage, never overkill.

summary: Focus one gardener until dead, biggest attack first; race them down while Stone Armor soaks. Use ampoule when it kills chipped ones; weak potion only if a turn goes lethal; keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: All four up = ~15-20/turn; every kill cuts it. ENLARGE turns are free damage. Highest-damage attack first each turn (Skittish adds 6 block after the first hit).

summary: Race: play Stone Armor turn 1, then drive the eel to 70 HP on a CRASH turn for the free stun-cancel; Bash + Molten Fist burst after; weak potion early; stay above 50% HP for the boss.
key_turns: CRASH turns are biggest (23+): block fully. Land the damage push that crosses 70 HP on a CRASH turn so the stun cancels that attack.

summary: Free T1: Stone Armor + Howl from Beyond for recurring 24/turn, then Bash+ into Molten Fist for 6 Vulnerable. Block DE_GAS/SCREAM, defend through FADE, Attack Potion on the post-intangible burst turn.
key_turns: T1 Beckon is free: set up. T2 DE_GAS 20 and T5 SCREAM 13: block fully. FADE turn = intangible, don't attack; exhaust Beckons (Second Wind/True Grit).

summary: T1 Stone Armor (power triggers free card) then Howl from Beyond+ for recurring 24/turn. Block BEES turns, burst on its buff turn, finish with Feed+ for +4 max HP; keep HP for the boss ahead.
key_turns: BEES 3×7 turns need full block; PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn = burst (Duplicator+Ultimate Strike+, then Feed+ finish). Limit small attacks (each adds Dazed); exhaust Dazed with Second Wind/True Grit.

summary: T1 play Howl+ into exhaust with Stone Armor and block. It re-fires 24 AoE each turn end; after T2 all segments are at or below 24 HP and die together, no reattach. Hold the attack potion.
key_turns: T1: block 24 (Anchor+plated armor). T2: do NOT attack; Howl's end-of-turn 24 kills all three segments at once — killing one early makes it reattach at 25.

summary: T1 is free: play Howl+ so it re-fires 24 every turn, then Crimson Mantle+/Stone Armor. Then race the sandpit timer with vulnerable-boosted attacks, full-blocking the 29 bite; attack potion for the closing burst.
key_turns: Enemy buff/status turns: slam powers and attacks freely. On LUNGING_BITE 29 turns full-block. When sandpit ≤2, play Frantic Escape first, then burst.

summary: Play Howl+ first so it re-fires 24 AOE every turn; set up Crimson Mantle+ and Stone Armor; focus Flail Knight to cut RAM damage; block T2; save Fysh Oil for boss.
key_turns: T2 ~40 dmg: block fully. Kill Magi before T4 MAGIC_BOMB 35 if Howl+ not re-firing. T4 Flail buff = free damage.

summary: Ramp fight: play powers first, strip 3 Artifact then Bash+ / Molten Fist / Dominate for +6 strength; Fysh Oil turn 1; fully block the 25 and 42 turns; kill around turn 8-9.
key_turns: T1 CHARGE 25: powers plus full block. WINDUP turn is free setup (Dominate). Save Colossus+ and 佩尔的士兵 for HEAVY_CLEAVE 42 after its buff.

summary: Howl+ turn 1 re-fires 24/turn from exhaust — win condition. Crimson Mantle+ and Stone Armor early for sustain. Strip artifacts, stack Vulnerable, then Dominate for Strength. Colossus+ halves Ebb/Laser hits. Kill by turn 9.
key_turns: Strip Artifact 3 (Taunt/Uppercut) before Bash/Molten Fist/Demise. Ebb & Eye-Lasers turns: Colossus+. Post-Ebb turns (T2/5/8): 33 block — block first, overflow attacks; few big cards (wither).

summary: Turn 1 is free (INFECT): play Rupture then Inferno. Block LASH 16 with Blood Wall, which also fires Inferno and grows strength. Race it down, then AOE the Infested spawns. Keep HP and Power Potion for Ceremonial Beast.
key_turns: T1 INFECT is free: play Rupture+Inferno. LASH turns: Blood Wall blocks 16 and triggers Inferno/+1 strength. After death, its spawns need AOE — Howl/Breakthrough.

summary: Turn 1 is a free stun turn: play Rupture then Inferno. Then each self-damage (Breakthrough, Blood Wall) triggers Inferno's 6 AOE plus Rupture strength; plus Howl kills the four 17-20 HP wrigglers by turn 2-3. Save Power Potion for Ceremoni…
key_turns: T1 free (all stunned): Rupture then Inferno. T2-T3: Breakthrough/Blood Wall self-damage double-procs Inferno (6 AOE each) plus Rupture strength; Howl finishes. Block the 8-damage bites if any survive.

summary: Set Rupture+Inferno turns 1-2 behind block; each self-damage now deals 6 and adds strength. Blood Wall/Breakthrough chip, double Howl finishes by turn 4. Power potion: keep for the boss unless this fight goes critical.
key_turns: T1-2: take 17/18 while powers go up, block with Taunt/Blood Wall. Its strength grows every turn, so don't stall; Howl (18 then replays 18) closes by turn 4.

summary: Use the two charge-up turns for Rupture, Inferno and Demon Form from the power potion, stacking strength via self-damage. Keep vulnerable up so Colossus halves the big PLOW/CRUSH hits, fully block attack turns, then burst past 150 HP for t…
key_turns: Turns 1-2 free: Rupture+Inferno, Power potion->Demon Form. PLOW ramps 9/20/24 and CRUSH 18+: block with Colossus+vulnerable or Blood Wall. Burst below 150 for the stun.

summary: Set up Rupture+Inferno by turn 3, block spear turns with Taunt/Colossus/Blood Wall; race with AOE and self-damage triggers; Ashwater clears Daze. Keep HP for boss; finish before Daze clogs.
key_turns: Spear turns (2,5,8...) hit 19: Colossus+Taunt or Blood Wall. Buff turns (3,6) are free: play powers/attacks. Bee turns 3×7: Flame Barrier. Daze clog: True Grit/Ashwater.

summary: 31 HP: cannot race. Turns 1-2 (enemy buffs) play Rupture then Inferno; thereafter block every attack turn and self-damage with Blood Wall/Breakthrough to stack strength plus 6-damage AOE; Colossus/Taunt for 29 hits.
key_turns: LUNGE 29 and 21/18 attack turns: full block (Colossus+Taunt/Flame Barrier), potion if short. Salivate turn = free setup. Play Frantic Escape when sandpit <=2.

summary: Race: Bash then Molten Fist for doubled Vulnerability, dump all attacks, block with Shrug It Off/Defends to blunt the 17-20 hits, kill within 4 turns before its Strength snowballs. Both potions turn 1.
key_turns: No free turns: 17 now, 18 next, then 20+ as Strength grows. Kill by turn 4; block big hits; both potions turn 1.

summary: Race: T1–2 free — Bloodletting, Bash then Molten Fist (4 Vuln), all attacks, cheap cards first for Slow. From T3 block 23/turn with Shrug It Off/Defends while attacking; keep HP for the Kin boss.
key_turns: T1–2 asleep: free offense, no Defends. T3+ SLASHES 23 every turn — block with Shrug/Defends while racing; Molten Fist exhausts, use the doubled-Vulnerability window, end by ~T6.

summary: Race the followers: burst the left one with Bash+ then Molten Fist (Vulnerable doubled), Bloodletting and Energy Potion for tempo; block the Beam and post-Ritual turns; keep HP ≥50% for Act 2.
key_turns: Beam turn (T3) and post-Ritual turns are the damage spikes: full block. Frail/Weak turns are safe to attack. Kill followers before they double-buff.

summary: Race the 161 HP elite: Inflame turn 1-2, Bash+ then Molten Fist for 6 vuln, Dismantle bursts. Block buffed JAB/WHIRLWIND turns; Speed potion on a 20+ hit, Blood potion only under ~30 HP.
key_turns: PULSATE's buff makes later JAB/WHIRLWIND hit 20+; full-block those, Flame Barrier into WHIRLWIND. Kill by turn 6-7 before buffs compound.

summary: Inflame+/Brand turn 1-2; spread damage evenly, block buffed turns; finish all three segments in one Stomp turn to skip reattach. Forge potion on the burst turn, blood potion emergency only.
key_turns: Buffed WRITHE/CONSTRICT turns after BULK (+6 Str): spend all on block, no greed; hold Stomp until all three segments die together, a lone kill reattaches at 25 HP.

summary: Setup Pyre + Inflame+ turn 1 (free turn), second Inflame later; race via Bash+ -> Molten Fist -> Dismantle. Flame Barrier and Dexterity potion for turns 3/7 multi-hits; Forge potion on a burst hand; stay above 35 HP.
key_turns: T1/T5 free, no attack: powers. T3/T7 multi-hits ~30: Flame Barrier + Dexterity potion, never eat Withering stacks. Bash+ -> Molten Fist -> Dismantle burst; Forge potion on that burst hand.

summary: Grind it down: chip 15-20 per turn (cap makes burst wasted), Bash for vulnerable, Battle Trance for draw, block the 18/15 turns, finish in ~5 turns keeping most HP.
key_turns: Full block on PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15; on INERTIA (9+buff) take the hit and dump damage; respect per-turn damage cap, spread hits evenly.

summary: Long attrition: Brand stacks strength, Bash then Molten Fist doubles vulnerable for burst, Purity/Brand consume Beckons, block the 21 and 13, idle through Intangible turns.
key_turns: BECKON turns: free damage, exhaust Beckons with Purity/Brand. DE_GAS 21 and SCREAM 13: full block plus Weak. After FADE: no attacks (Intangible), play skills only.

summary: No powers, so grind: let her sleep, wake with a vuln-first burst. Taunt+Colossus zeroes the 21/20 turns; full-attack SOUL_SIPHON and 9x2 turns. Insanity on Bash+, Glowwater when hand is junk.
key_turns: T1-4 asleep/stun: no attacks. Big hits (SLASH 21 / DISEMBOWEL 20): Taunt+Colossus nullifies them. Buff turn and 9x2 turn: full attack with vulnerable up.

summary: Race the elite: Crimson Mantle turn 1, vulnerable via Bash+/Taunt+, then burst with Dismantle+/Bully. On BEES turns stack Taunt+/Flame Barrier/Colossus. Fewer attack cards means fewer Dazed; keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: BEES 3×7 turns: add vulnerable, then Colossus halves it to ~10 and Flame Barrier reflects 12; Spear 19 turns block fully. Apply vulnerable before Bully/Dismantle+.

summary: No-attack Liquify/Salivate turns: play both powers and swing freely; keep vulnerable up so Colossus halves the 29 lunge; block attack turns hard, Speed+Weak potions on the lunge; Feed the kill if lethal.
key_turns: Liquify/Salivate (no attack): play powers, swing freely. LUNGING_BITE 29 is the fear turn: Colossus + Flame Barrier + Speed/Weak potions. Escapes only when sandpit ≤2.

summary: Long 3-life elite (~250 HP): grow via Inflame/powers early, block every turn (frailty cuts block 25%), never trade HP for a revive-triggering kill. One power potion now; keep the second for Queen; Feed as finisher.
key_turns: T1-2 safe (crown block): play powers. Revive BOOT_UP turns deal no damage — set up. Life 3's 20 and 16x2 under frailty: pre-stack block, Colossus on multi-hits.

summary: Long 234 HP elite: turns 1-2 play Crimson Mantle, Inflame, Stone Armor+ under crown block; then vulnerable + multi-attacks, blocking every 29-34 hit. Never trade HP before the queen boss.
key_turns: Big-hit turns (29/31/34): full block with Flame Barrier, Colossus, Taunt+; vulnerable first, then Dismantle+/Bully burst. Turn 1 free under diamond-crown block.

summary: Demon Form then Inflame/Crimson Mantle in the debuff-free first turns, blocking tackles. All damage on the Amalgam (Feed finisher = +3 max HP). After it dies, block Queen's 斩首/处决 cycle while strength grows.
key_turns: T1-2 are debuff-free: only one chained card each turn. From T3, 99 vuln/weak/frail (all damage ×1.5) — block BEAM 8×3 and post-Amalgam 5-hit 斩首.

summary: Race with vulnerable: Bash then Molten Fist (4x vulnerable) and Uppercut (weak) early, cross 70 HP fast to cancel CRASH and get two free attack turns; otherwise block big hits, fight ends well above 50 HP for the boss.
key_turns: CRASH 16-23 turns: block with Shrug/Defend or Colossus (halves damage while it is vulnerable); push it below 70 HP during CRASH to cancel that attack, then use the STUNNED/TERROR free turns for full …

summary: Long attrition: keep it Vulnerable so Colossus halves its 19/18 hits and Uppercut's Weak cuts them; don't damage it during sleep; burst once it wakes/stuns; Blood Potion only if low.
key_turns: 1-3 asleep: don't attack (Plating absorbs); cycle+draw, Bash last sleep turn. Wake/stun turn: dump Molten Fist/Uppercut. Later: Colossus+Weak vs 19, block 9x2, buff turn = free hits.

summary: Stone Armor early, Bash+ then Molten Fist for vulnerable burst; race below 70 HP to trigger attack-cancelling stun, block CRASH turns, save HP for Waterfall Giant.
key_turns: Full-block CRASH turns (23+, scales with THRASH buffs). Cross below 70 HP in one burst to cancel its attack (stun); TERROR turn free. Weak potion for 23+ hits.

summary: Race; skip powers (Plated Armor decays to many small hits). Bash+ then Molten Fist on one Gardener (vuln x6), all attacks on one target per turn — Skittish wastes spread damage. Stay above 55 HP.
key_turns: T1 ~15 dmg; ENLARGE buffs worsen later turns — kill one Gardener per ~2 turns. Full block when 3+ attack together (~25); keep HP >55 for the boss.

summary: Play both 1-cost powers turns 1-2 (Crimson Mantle+ = 10 block/turn, Stone Armor = 4), then deal ~20 each turn with Bash+/Molten Fist/Dismantle while blocking 14-18 hits; keep HP for Waterfall Giant.
key_turns: Turn 1 (14) and turns 3-4 (18, 15): block fully. Turn 2 INERTIA buff: no attack, play powers/hit freely. Cap limits damage to ~20/turn, so fight lasts 4+ turns.

summary: Turn 1 boss buffs, so play Crimson Mantle+ and Stone Armor. Then Bash+ vulnerable, double it with Molten Fist, follow with Dismantle/Unrelenting. Race before Pressure Gun reaches 30; fully block the self-destruct.
key_turns: Turn 1 it buffs: play powers free. Explode turn after the kill: full block plus Block potion; keep HP above eruption stacks (15, +3/turn); burst right after Siphon's heal.

summary: Play Crimson Mantle+ and Stone Armor early for a per-turn block engine, then spread damage evenly across all three segments. Kill all in one turn (Stomp+ plus Stomp) — dead segments revive at 25 HP otherwise.
key_turns: BULK turns add +6 strength each, so later turns hurt far more; block fully. Finish turn: all three segments at ≤27 HP, play attacks first to discount Stomp+ (15) + Stomp (12).

summary: T1 curse turn: Crimson Mantle+ and Stone Armor, then race with vulnerable (Bash+/Taunt+ into Molten Fist/Dismantle+/Fiend Fire+). Block overwhelm turns; attack potion on burst turn, skill potion as emergency.
key_turns: T1/5/9 curse turns free: powers then attacks. T2/6 SLAP 17-21. T3/7/11 overwhelm 30-42: full block. T4/8 PONDER heals 30 and gains strength — burst to end early.

summary: Hardened Shell caps it at 20 damage/turn, so plan 4+ turns: Inflame early, Bash+ for vulnerable, hit the cap while blocking 14/18/15. Attack potion stays for the Soul Fysh boss.
key_turns: Danger: PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15 turns - full block, Flame Barrier on the 18. INERTIA (no-attack) turn is free: Inflame and dump damage.

summary: Inflame+ and Bash+ on the free turn 1, then grind: full-block the 21s and 13s, attack on GAZE/BECKON turns, use Attack Potion on a vulnerable burst turn; never attack into Intangible.
key_turns: DE_GAS 21: full block (Flame Barrier+Shrug It Off). While INTANGIBLE is up: no attacks, block/play skills only. GAZE/BECKON turns: Bash vulnerability then attack; limit draw when Beckons lurk.

summary: Inflame+ turns 1-2. Grind both claws evenly behind blocks; save Flame Barrier for 43-laser. Chip to ~30 HP each, then kill both in one turn (Feed last hit, +3 max HP).
key_turns: ROCKET CHARGE_UP→LASER 43 (+claw 18-22): full block, Flame Barrier/Shrugs. Keep claw HP even; never solo-kill (99 block+6 str). Burst both down same turn with Flex+Stomp+.

summary: One enemy, per-turn damage cap ~20: slow attrition. Play Pyre and Caltrops first (free on buff turns), block each attack, deal up to cap per turn, never overcommit HP. Burning Blood heals after.
key_turns: Hardened Shell caps damage at ~20/turn, so it needs 4+ turns: land Pyre/Caltrops on the INERTIA buff turn, chip ~20 each turn, and fully block PIERCING_STABS 18; Beetle Juice if that turn can't be co…

summary: Pyre turn 1-2, then grind: block CRASH turns, chip on buff turns; time Hemokinesis/Fiend Fire (+Howl echo) to cross 70 HP while it attacks for a free stun. Keep both potions for the boss explosion.
key_turns: CRASH turns (~23, grows after THRASH buffs): full block with Flame Barrier/Evil Eye. Push it below 70 on an attack turn to trigger SHRIEK stun, cancelling that attack.

summary: Play Pyre and Caltrops free on turn 1, then block every big hit, keep HP above steam stacks, kill steadily, and pre-stack block plus Beetle Juice so EXPLODE cannot kill.
key_turns: T1 is a free Buff turn: Pyre then Caltrops. Block Pressure Gun 20-30; on ABOUT_TO_BLOW stack all block + Beetle Juice for EXPLODE; never let HP drop below steam stacks.

summary: Play Demon Form+ then Pyre, take Caltrops free. Block the multi-hits while Baking Gloves and Demon Form ramp strength, then one Whirlwind/Howl turn killing all three segments at once — never one alone (25 HP reattach).
key_turns: Turns 1-2 are setup, damage is small. BULK adds +6 strength each use, so turns 4+ hurt: block fully then. Kill turn only when all three die together, else no reattach waste.

summary: Setup T1-2: Demon Form+, Pyre, Dark Embrace. Send both Howls to the exhaust pile for 18×2 free damage each turn; Baking Gloves adds strength. Block the big bites; win the sandpit race.
key_turns: Buff turns (SALIVATE/LIQUIFY) are free: play powers/damage. Block fully on LUNGING_BITE 29 and THRASH 18/21. Sandpit ≤2: play Frantic Escape first.

summary: Race with AOE: Howl then Breakthrough in the first two turns, then kill low-HP gardeners one at a time (first hit each turn is unreduced). Block the biggest turns; do not let buffs stack.
key_turns: T3-5 once ENLARGE buffs stack: incoming 25+, full block or Weak potion there. Get Howl + Breakthrough down by T2; finish 1-4 HP survivors with one full hit each.

summary: Race 211 HP boss: turn 1 Howl, then Bash+ into Molten Fist for vulnerable burst; block DE_GAS 21 and SCREAM 13; never attack during FADE intangible; True Grit clears Beckon.
key_turns: DE_GAS 21 and SCREAM 13: full block. FADE/intangible turn: no attacks, play skills, exhaust Beckon. Clear Beckon before end of turn.

summary: Setup Pyre then Howl (18 free/turn), block the 21/19 attack turns, burst with Bash+ into Molten Fist (vuln 6). Save Feed for the killing blow; skip small attacks (Dazed). Ashwater saved for the boss.
key_turns: Block turns: BEES (3×7, up to 26) and SPEAR 19 — never eat these below 20 HP; PHEROMONE_SPIT is the free turn: dump damage.

summary: Race 321 HP before the sandpit clock. T1 Pyre+Inferno, T2 Howl (18/turn recurring). Block the 29/21 hits fully; Bash+→Molten Fist vuln window on free turns; Tonic for a bite; Ashwater clears junk.
key_turns: Bite-29 turns (T3/T7/T11): full block; Tonic blanks one. 21/18 turns: block most; free buff turns: Bash+ then Molten Fist, dump damage. Sandpit ≤2: Escape before attacking.
