summary: Race the 64-HP elite: Bash/Uppercut for vulnerability, Setup Strike before multi-hits, burst it down. Block the 16-damage LASH, ignore Feel No Pain, and keep both potions for Vantom's dismember turn.
key_turns: LASH turn: block 16 fully. INFECT turns: dump attacks freely — status cards clog, so kill in ~4 turns; then clear spawned minions with Sword Boomerang.

summary: Phrog's spawn: four stunned Wrigglers, 77 HP total. Go full offense now — Setup Strike before both Boomerangs; kill lowest-HP bugs first to cut bites. Block the 8×4 wave, skip Feel No Pain.
key_turns: T1 all stunned: free full offense. T2 they WRIGGLE-buff, keep attacking. T3 bite wave 8×4=32: full block or speed potion, kill stragglers first.

summary: Strip all 8 SLIPPERY with multi-hits (both Boomerangs, Twin Strike) turn 1, then Bash/Taunt vulnerable and dump damage; full-block DISMEMBER turns; attack potion on a PREPARE burst turn; race before Wounds clog the deck.
key_turns: Turn 3 DISMEMBER 27 +3 Wounds: Uppercut for Weak, block fully. Turn 4 PREPARE: no damage, drink potion and dump attacks. Repeat each 4-turn cycle.

summary: Feel No Pain, then Howl for recurring 18 AOE plus block; Brand and Baking Glove stack strength. Block the ~24-damage turns, whittle all three evenly, then Duplicator finisher when all three die together.
key_turns: WRITHE 12-13 and CONSTRICT turns: full block, no greedy damage. Hold Duplicator for the single turn all three segments die together; lone kills reattach at 25 HP.

summary: Sleep/wake turns are free: stack vuln (Bash+, Molten Fist) and burst Dismantle. Then block each 23 SLASHES turn with Flame Barrier/Taunt while attacking; save Power Potion for Vantom.
key_turns: Turns 1-2 free (sleep/wake): chain Bash+ -> Molten Fist, then Dismantle burst. From turn 3, full-block the 23 SLASHES with Flame Barrier/Taunt and kill fast.

summary: Power Potion turn 1 for Demon Form, the win condition. Strip 8 Slippery with multi-hits; Molten Fist doubles vuln. Full block plus Buffer on T3 Dismember; Burning Pact eats Wounds; T4 Prepare is free damage.
key_turns: T3 Dismember 27 + 3 Wounds: full block, Flame Barrier, Lucky Tonic Buffer; T4 Prepare: free all-out damage turn. Strip Slippery before any big single hit.

summary: Race the Giant: Bash+ then Molten Fist to stack vulnerability, use draws for damage, keep HP above eruption stacks, and save Colossus plus block cards for the EXPLODE turn; Speed Potion covers it.
key_turns: ABOUT_TO_BLOW: draw, hold block cards. EXPLODE: Colossus (vuln up) + full block + Speed Potion. Pressure Gun grows 20→30, block every turn; keep HP above eruption stacks.

summary: Inflame early for permanent strength; Thunderclap and Bash/Molten Fist for vulnerability; kill both followers first (59/58 HP), then grind the 190 HP priest before its RITUAL strength stacks; potions for finishing followers.
key_turns: Priest RITUAL = free damage turn. ORB_OF_FRAILTY weakens our block next turn: hold Shrug/Taunt for BEAM 12 plus both followers. Kill followers before POWER_DANCE strength stacks.

summary: Bash then Molten Fist to double vulnerable, race to 70 HP to trigger the stun on a big-attack turn, block crashes, Radiant Tincture early for extra energy.
key_turns: CRASH (20+) turns: block fully. Push it below 70 HP during a CRASH turn so the stun cancels that hit; THRASH turns it buffs — race before damage grows.

summary: Play Inflame on the free buff turn, then block the 14-18 attack turns with Defends/Evil Eye while chipping steadily. Damage per turn is capped, so expect 4-5 turns; drink Clarity early to find Inflame and block, and stay high HP for the bo…
key_turns: INERTIA turn: no attack, play Inflame and attack freely. PIERCING_STABS 18 turn: full block with Defends/Evil Eye, no greed. Damage per turn is capped, so never stall.

summary: Setup Inflame+Rupture on the free turn, block the 21 and 13, burst on FADE/GAZE, avoid attacking while intangible; Rupture turns Beckon chip into strength.
key_turns: T1 BECKON: play powers. T2 DE_GAS 21: full block, DEX potion. T4 FADE: still hittable — Vulnerable potion + Bash+/Molten Fist burst. T5 SCREAM 13: intangible, block only.

summary: Play Inflame then Rupture while still blocking JAB; keep it vulnerable with Bash+/Molten Fist and race. Cover multi-hit turns with Flame Barrier, Colossus, Impervious; kill before its strength snowballs.
key_turns: PULSATE (no attack): free setup/damage. Later WHIRLWIND/RADIATE after strength stacks: full block with Flame Barrier/Impervious/Colossus while it's vulnerable; drink Dexterity there.

summary: Play both Inflames and Rupture while blocking the 18/3 opener; then chip both claws evenly, tank the laser, and finish both in one turn to avoid Crab Rage.
key_turns: Rocket charge-up precedes LASER 43: block hard with Impervious+Colossus (apply vulnerable first). Guarded Strike 22/Bug Sting 20 need real block. Keep claw HP even; kill both same turn.

summary: Race the four elites: one at a time, Howl from Beyond ASAP (18 to all, unblocked first hits), block the 20+ incoming turns; save Vulnerable potion for the Waterfall Giant boss, Swift potion if it finds Howl or lethal.
key_turns: ENLARGE and any 20+ incoming turn: block hard. Kill one at a time, lowest HP first; lead each target with the biggest hit (first attack is unblocked).

summary: Race 240: play Howl immediately (it replays free at end of turn), Bash/Taunt+ first, dump attacks; Flex on a multi-attack burst turn. Kill by T5 to cap the blast, then one full-block turn; keep HP above steam stacks.
key_turns: T2-4: Pressure Gun 22-25. Kill by T5 so EXPLODE ~27. On ABOUT_TO_BLOW dig block (Swift, Headbutt Shrug It Off+); next turn ignore wreck, block all.

summary: Play Howl+ turn 1 (4 energy): 24 now + 24 end-of-turn replay = 48 to all, killing the 44/42/46 segments together. Otherwise block and dig; never kill segments piecemeal. Potions only for the all-kill burst.
key_turns: T1 is the kill turn: Howl 24+24 wipes 44/42/46 together. If missing, block ~24/turn (8, 5x2, 6) and dig; never kill one segment alone — it reattaches at 25.

summary: Long grind, no strength: turn 1 Howl+ (48 AOE) + Crimson Mantle; Battle Trance+ digs, Headbutt+ recurs Howl+. Keep claws even; vulnerable potion on the double-kill turn; block potion on LASER 43.
key_turns: Fear Rocket's CHARGE_UP→LASER 43: full block + Block Potion. Block Crusher's 20-22 hits. Keep claws within ~10 HP; double-kill same turn; 历石/Howl+ replay must not kill one alone.

summary: Race the pack: focus one Wriggler at a time, buffing ones first, use Bash then Twin Strike/Molten Fist for kills, drink strength potion turn 1, spend Defends only on heavy incoming turns.
key_turns: Turns 2-3, after WRIGGLE buffs land, bites hit 8+ each; block with Defends those turns, kill the two buffing Wrigglers (20/17 HP) first so strength stops stacking.

summary: Turn 1 safe: Inflame first, then attack. Block the 16 LASH turns. Burst the parasite down with Bash+ vulnerability plus Fire Potion; when it dies 4 spawns appear, so save Stomp for them.
key_turns: LASH 16 turns (T2/T4) block fully; INFECT turns (T1/T3, 0 dmg) play Inflame then attack; vulnerable+Bash then Fire Potion for burst; keep Stomp for the 4 death-spawns.

summary: Free stun turn: Inflame, then damage; Stomp after attacks. Kill lowest-HP Wriggler first, one at a time. On all-bite turns block ~20 with Defends/True Grit; burst via Bash+ into Dismantle.
key_turns: This turn is free (all stunned): Inflame then attacks, Stomp last for discount. Fear the turn all four bite (32): block with Defends/True Grit or kill one first.

summary: Race the bird: Inflame turn 1, Bash+ then Molten Fist to double vulnerable, burst with Dismantle/Twin Strike, block the SWOOP turns. Save both potions for Vantom (speed potion for Dismember, power potion boss turn 1).
key_turns: Territorial strength makes every turn hit harder (17 now, 20+ by turn 3); attack first, then block big-hit turns with Blood Wall/True Grit. Kill by turn 4; drink only if HP <35.

summary: Play Inflame during the small-attack turns while HP is 79. Multi-hit attacks strip Slippery 8, then Bash+/Molten Fist feed Dismantle. Power Potion turn 1, Speed Potion on the 27 Dismember turn.
key_turns: Block INKY_LANCE (T2) and full-block DISMEMBER (T3, +3 wounds); PREPARE (T4) is the burst window. Break Slippery 8 with Twin Strike/Dismantle before Molten Fist doubling + Bash+ burst.

summary: Demon Form/Inflame first, block ~24+/turn; split damage evenly, then Flex + double Stomp + Exterminate one-turn kill all three segments — never kill one early. HP high for boss in 2 floors.
key_turns: BULK/strength turns make WRITHE/CONSTRICT hit harder — block those. Burst turn: Flex potion, kill all three together; a lone kill reattaches at 25 HP.

summary: Play Demon Form and Inflame early during small-attack turns; block fully when Rocket lasers or Crusher thrashes; spread AOE (Stomp/Whirlwind/Exterminate) to keep claw HP even, then kill both in one turn.
key_turns: Rocket's CHARGE_UP→LASER 44: full block with Flame Barrier/Blood Wall. CRUSHER THRASH 17 hurts. Keep both claws' HP within ~30; finish both same turn.

summary: Race: kill one gardener per turn, starting with the buffed/lowest-HP one, biggest attack first. Use the Ampoule early; keep the Block Potion as emergency so we enter Soul Fysh near full HP.
key_turns: Ampoule turn 1-2 for four targets; Bludgeon should one-shot the buffed 27-HP gardener. Skittish adds 6 block after the first attack card, so lead with the biggest hit.

summary: Turn 1 free: Inflame, Forgotten Ritual into Bludgeon, then race. Bash+ vulnerability first; Cinder exhausts Beckon; no attacks on intangible Fade turns. Block potion for De-Gas.
key_turns: De-Gas 21 and Scream 13 turns: full block. Fade/intangible turns: no attacks, play block or energy. Exhaust Beckon with Cinder; each Beckon is 6 unblockable per turn.

summary: Turn 1 Inflame (Cocoa gives extra energy) + Forgotten Ritual into Bludgeon, then Bash for vulnerable and race; block 15+ on PULSATE/WHIRLWIND turns; kill by turn 4-5, Fire Potion to finish.
key_turns: PULSATE buff turn and WHIRLWIND multi-hit turns need full block (Shrug/Colossus/Expect a Fight); Bash then Bludgeon for burst; Fire Potion closes the kill.

summary: Race the 30-point heals: Inflame turn 1, stack strength with Setup Strike + Vajra, then Bludgeon burst; fully block the 30-damage Overwhelming turns; potions fuel the burst; close before the third curse.
key_turns: T3/T7 Overwhelming 30 - full block; T4/T8 Ponder heals 30 - dump damage; T1 curse free: Inflame + burst; close by T9 third curse.

summary: Two free turns: Inflame, Crimson Mantle, then Bash+ into Molten Fist to bank six vulnerable; Bludgeon burst ~51, finish with cheap attacks. Block Slashes with Blood Wall/Shrug; Strength Potion on the burst, Heart of Iron only if HP sags.
key_turns: Turns 1-2 free (Sleep/Wake): play powers, then Bash+ into Molten Fist. On SLASHES 23 turns block with Blood Wall/Shrug unless the kill is lethal; bunch attacks for Slow.

summary: Use the two non-attacking turns for Inflame, Crimson Mantle and the Power Potion, then burst the beast below 150 to stun it; hold Heart of Iron for the first big PLOW/Crush and keep block for the one-card Ringing turn.
key_turns: T1 buff = free: play Inflame + Crimson Mantle. T2 has Candle energy: block PLOW 9. Race HP under 150 for the stun turn, dump everything; the Ringing turn after, play only Bludgeon. Respect Crush 18/P…

summary: Rush the 64 HP elite: turn 1 ritual then dump damage, block the LASH turns, hold AOE to clear the spawns it releases on death, and keep HP high for the boss.
key_turns: T2 and T4 LASH 16: block fully or pop Weak; on the kill turn have Stomp/Breakthrough ready — its death spawns the swarm.

summary: All four Wrigglers are stunned turn 1, so spend it killing the whole board with Breakthrough + Stomp AOE. Race, don't turtle; hold potions unless several survive and bite. Keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: T1 all stunned: free burst — Breakthrough then Stomp (21 AOE) wipes all 4. If any survive, T2 bites 8 each: block with Shrug, finish kills, Weak if 3+ alive.

summary: No powers in deck, so race. T1 Forgotten Ritual into Bash plus Twin Strikes for a burst; afterwards block the 23 Slashes with Shrug/Defends while attacks finish it. Stay high HP for the boss.
key_turns: T1-T2 free (Sleep/Wake): dump all damage. T3+ Slashes 23 every turn: cover with Shrug It Off (Bracer doubles first block) plus Defends, keep chipping; kill by turn 6.

summary: No powers, so race: turns 1-2 are free — apply vulnerable and dump damage, drive below 150 for the stun, then keep bursting. Block plow/Crush with Shrug It Off and the armaments relic.
key_turns: Plow turns 2-5 (9→20→22→24) and every Crush: block fully; race below 150 for the free stun; on the Ringing turn play only the biggest attack.

summary: Race the 145 HP Entomancer: Inflame, then vulnerable via Bash/Molten Fist and single big hits — multi-hit attacks each add Dazed. Block the 21/19 attacks fully; hold strength potion for Kaiser Crab.
key_turns: BEES 3×7 (21) and SPEAR 19 alternate; PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn is free — dump damage. First block card is doubled: use Shrug It Off/Flame Barrier then.

summary: Open Inflame + strength potion, block the 45 LASER, chip both claws evenly to ~50, then one AOE turn (Stomp + Whirlwind+) kills both. Ashwater stays saved.
key_turns: Rocket LASER (45): full block with Flame Barrier, no racing. Keep claw HP even; never solo-kill (99 block/+6 str). Finish both with Stomp + Whirlwind in one turn.

summary: Low HP, so open Inflame/Rupture while Apparitions eat Cleave 42 and Charge 25; strip Artifact 3, drop Vulnerable potion on a big burst turn, then race the 300 HP down.
key_turns: HEAVY_CLEAVE 42 and CHARGE 25: blank with Apparition or full block; WINDUP buff turn is free to attack/setup. Strip 3 Artifact with Bash/Taunt before Vulnerable potion, then burst.

summary: Race the four gardeners: Stone Armor turn 1 (draws 2), then focus the lowest-HP gardener each turn, highest-damage attack first (Skittish 6 blocks later hits). Keep HP 55+ for the boss.
key_turns: ENLARGE turns: that gardener won't attack, hit another. After buffs three-four attackers land ~25+: full block, drink Dexterity potion. Fear turns 4-6.

summary: Do not wake her early: use the three sleep turns for Stone Armor, draw, and banked block. After she wakes, block the 21 hits, spend energy on Bludgeon/Uppercut on Soul Siphon and vulnerable turns, grind 222 HP.
key_turns: T1–3 asleep: powers/setup only, no attacks — don't wake her; on T3 bank block for the first hit. Then block the 21 and 9×2 turns; attack freely on Soul Siphon.

summary: Race: powers early (Crimson Mantle, Stone Armor, FNP), block the attack turns, burst with Unrelenting into free Bludgeon, big hits not Strike spam since each attack adds Dazed.
key_turns: Block every BEES 3×7 and SPEAR 19 turn (Crimson Mantle 10 + Shrug/Defends). PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn: free damage, Unrelenting into 0-cost Bludgeon. Kill by turn 6 before Dazed clogs.

summary: Play Mantle+/Stone Armor/FNP early behind full block; keep all three segments' HP even and burst them down together (Stomp+Howl+Bludgeon, Attack Potion) to skip reattaches; watch BULK strength and constrict.
key_turns: Block the 24+ incoming while BULK stacks +6/turn; never kill a lone segment (reattach 25); sync-kill all three with Stomp+Howl on the burst turn, potion then.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Mantle+, Stone Armor, FNP+ behind block; from turn 3 (extra energy) grind both claws evenly at near-equal HP; block charge-up→LASER 45; burst both dead the same turn, never one alone.
key_turns: ROCKET's CHARGE_UP is followed by LASER 45 — full block that turn; Crusher's 17-21 hits and BUG_STING 20 also need blocking; finish both claws in one Stomp + double Howl turn.

summary: Play Mantle+, Stone Armor, FNP+ early behind block; attacks only in phase 1 to deny Enrage. Block phase 2's ramping claws while racing. Phase 3: Setup Strike then cheap multi-hits; exhaust Dazed on respawn turns.
key_turns: Phase 1 attacks only (Enrage). Phase 2 claws 30→60: Speed Potion, full block, kill within 4 turns. Phase 3: Setup Strike first, many small hits; respawn turns exhaust Dazed.

summary: Multi-turn chip fight: damage capped near 20/turn, so 4+ turns. Stone Armor first, then trade 20 damage per turn while blocking the 14/18/15 hits. Save Lucky Tonic for the boss Explode.
key_turns: After Inertia (no attack) the spikes are Piercing Stabs 18 and Zoom 15: full block those, use Weak Tonic if HP drops below 55. Inertia turn is free damage.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Stone Armor then Aggression; use Bash+ vulnerability and Ampoule to burst the Eel under 70 for the stun; grind with Blood Wall blocking; keep Buffer for boss Explode.
key_turns: Cross 70 HP on a CRASH turn to cancel the 23 hit; full-block or Buffer CRASH turns. THRASH buffs each cycle—no dragging past ~8 turns.

summary: Play Stone Armor and Aggression in the first two turns (Mummified Hand makes them free), focus-fire lowest-HP gardener, lead each target with the biggest attack (Skittish blocks later hits), block multi-attacker turns. No potions; bank HP …
key_turns: Turns where 3-4 gardeners attack (LASH 8 chain, ~25): Blood Wall + Defend, Spite doubled. ENLARGE buff turns: full attack. Kill 26->28->30->31 HP.

summary: Race with Bash+ vulnerability, Dismantle and Spite; powers turn 1 for plated armor. Block Pressure Gun fully, keep HP above steam stacks, full-block the Explode turn.
key_turns: T1 free: Stone Armor+ > Stone Armor > Aggression. Early Touch of Insanity on Blood Wall or Bash+. Explode turn: full block, HP above stacks (15+3/turn).

summary: Turns 1-2 play Stone Armor+, Aggression, Stone Armor (powers make hand cards free); then vulnerability into Dismantle/Spite; keep 12+ block vs multi-hits; Feed the kill.
key_turns: JAB 15 now; RADIATE/WHIRLWIND multi-hits follow; block those fully, Uppercut weak for the worst; PULSATE buff turn—push damage; land Feed for the kill.

summary: Long chip fight: play powers early, spread damage evenly across the three segments, block the multi-hit turns, then kill all three in one burst turn. Save potion for the boss.
key_turns: BULK/WRITHE/CONSTRICT turns hit for 13+9+18; block hard, keep plated armor. Never solo-kill a segment (reattaches at 25). Finish by killing all three the same turn.

summary: Turn 1-2 setup all three powers (Stone Armor+ > Stone Armor > Aggression). Keep vulnerable up, play Frantic Escape only when sandpit <=2, block 29-hit turns, and use Blessing + Fire Potion on a big vulnerable attack turn.
key_turns: SALIVATE is free: play powers. Later THRASH 18/20 and LUNGING_BITE 29: fully block the 29. Play Frantic Escape only when sandpit <=2; burst with Blessing + Fire on a vulnerable attack turn.

summary: Stack plated armor via powers turns 1-2 while blocking what we can; strip artifacts with Bash+ before debuffs; full block the 42 cleave; burst on WINDUP turns; fire potion to finish. Keep HP for Test Subject boss.
key_turns: T1 CHARGE 25: Stone Armor+, block rest. HEAVY_CLEAVE 42: Impervious/Blood Wall. WINDUP: attack/setup free. Strip ARTIFACT with Bash+ before any vulnerable/weak, else Taunt wasted.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Stone Armor+ and Aggression while blocking ~20+. Then keep Vulnerable up (Bash+/Uppercut/Mad Science, whose Weak also cuts its hits) and race with Dismantle, Pommel+, Twin Strike. Speed/Fire potions on big 32-34 turns; exit …
key_turns: No fixed cycle: 20-34 hit every turn. Fully block the 32/34 turns with Impervious/Blood Wall; turn 2+ play Aggression; after lipstick turn 3, race and kill by ~turn 7.

summary: Turns 1-2: play Inflame, Stone Armor+, Aggression while blocking; Duplicator on Inflame. Phase 1 kill fast with attacks, no skills. Phase 2 block claws and race. Phase 3 use multi-hits on non-intangible turns, keep 40+ HP.
key_turns: P1: powers only, attacks over skills (Enrage +2), ~3-turn kill. P2: claws 10xN grow — Impervious/Blood Wall full blocks, race <=4 turns. P3: burst only when intangible is down; respawn turns = free s…

summary: Attrition grind vs 20 dmg/turn cap: deal ~20 each turn, spend rest on block, kill in 4-5 turns, HP stays high; Strength potion saved for Matriarch burst.
key_turns: INERTIA (buff, no attack) is the free damage turn. Fully block PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15 with Blood Wall/Shrug; hard cap 20 damage per turn, so no overkill.

summary: Pass the 3 sleep turns untouched — waking her early only buys extra enemy attacks. Burst on the free Soul-Siphon turn with Bash vulnerable, then deal ~20/turn while blocking the 19 and 9x2 hits.
key_turns: T1-3 asleep: no attacks (>12 damage wakes her early; less is absorbed by Plating). Free Soul-Siphon wake turn: Bash vulnerable + full burst. Then block the 19 and 9x2 turns with Blood Wall/Shrug.

summary: At 42 HP race the 145 HP Entomancer: Taunt early for vulnerable, prefer big single attacks (each attack adds a Dazed), full block on BEES turns, Feed for the kill, fire potion to close.
key_turns: BEES 3×7/26: full block, weak potion if line bleeds HP; PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn: dump all damage; SPEAR 18: block normally.

summary: Hardened Shell caps it at 20 damage/turn, so no burst: play Stone Armor, Bash+ then Molten Fist for 6 vulnerable, block each 14-18 attack, chip steadily. Save Attack Potion for boss burst.
key_turns: PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15: full-block these. INERTIA buff turn: free attacks/powers. Every turn hit the 20-damage cap, no more.

summary: Turn 1 Stone Armor (Beckon turn, no damage). Block hard on 21/13 attack turns, attack on other turns, skip attacks during Fade intangible. Avoid over-drawing Beckons; race at ~28 dmg/turn while holding HP.
key_turns: DE_GAS 21 and SCREAM 13 turns: full block (Shrug+, Defends). FADE turn is intangible: no attacks, play skills only. Don't over-draw—Beckons in hand cost 6 unblockable.

summary: Cycle: BEES→SPEAR→SPIT. Play Pyre+, Inflame, Stone Armor+ early behind block, then race: Bash+/Taunt vuln first, Molten Fist+/Dismantle+ after. Few big hits limit Dazed; Attack Potion for the burst kill.
key_turns: BEES 3×7 and SPEAR 18 are the danger turns: block fully, Stone Armor+ needed before them. The Pheromone Spit turn deals 0 — dump attacks/powers there.

summary: One 75-HP elite: cap 20 damage per turn. Set up Hellraiser and Fight Me on the free INERTIA turn, apply Bash/Taunt vulnerability, deal ~20 each turn, block the 18/15/14 attacks. Save Fortifier for Waterfall Giant's explosion.
key_turns: INERTIA turn is free: play Hellraiser/Fight Me and attack. On PIERCING_STABS 18, Taunt+Colossus halves it; fully block ZOOM 15/14. Deal ~20/turn; Bludgeon overkills the 20 cap.

summary: Set up Hellraiser and Fight Me!, Bash for vulnerable, then Duplicated Bludgeon to burst past 70 HP and cancel its CRASH. Bank block with Solid Claws; Fortifier stays for the boss explosion.
key_turns: CRASH 23 turns: full block, or Bash then Colossus to halve it. Cross 70 HP with Duplicated Bludgeon on an attack turn to cancel its hit; buff/TERROR turns: powers, bank block.

summary: Turns 1-2 are free (buff only): Hellraiser, Fight Me!, Bash+. Then race with vulnerable, Bludgeon, Sword Boomerang, staying above eruption stacks. Bank block on ABOUT_TO_BLOW, Fortifier for EXPLODE, survive and win.
key_turns: Kill by ~T8. Bank block on ABOUT_TO_BLOW/Siphon turns (Sturdy Clamp). EXPLODE: full block + Fortifier. Pressure Gun escalates each cycle; Bash+ vuln before Bludgeon/multi-hit bursts.

summary: Bash+ turn 1 buys 3 turns of vulnerability; block 21/18 with cheap blocks; use the free pheromone turn for Hellraiser plus all-in burst; pair One-Two Punch with Hemokinesis; kill by turn 5-6 to save HP for Knowledge Demon.
key_turns: T1 BEES 21 and T2 SPEAR 18: Bash+ then cheap block (Shrug/Taunt/Colossus with vuln up). T3 PHEROMONE_SPIT buff deals 0: free turn, play Hellraiser and burst. T4+ BEES escalates to ~26: keep Colossus/…

summary: Bash for vulnerable on the free INFECT turn, then burst during INFECT turns and block 16 every LASH turn. Burning Pact clears status clog; save Blood Potion as emergency heal only.
key_turns: LASH turns (T2/T4, 16 dmg): block 16 with Defend/Shrug/Taunt. INFECT turns are free damage windows; after the kill expect minion spawns — keep Sword Boomerang and energy ready.

summary: Race the pack: free stun turn goes all-in on damage, then focus one Wriggler at a time (Bash for vulnerable), blocking the bite turns; Blood Potion only as emergency heal.
key_turns: Turn 1: all four are stunned — full burst, kill one. Later turns: up to 32 incoming if all bite; block with Shrug/Taunt. Kill one per turn before WRIGGLE strength stacks.

summary: Drink Fysh Oil turn 1, Bash a follower for vulnerable, Sword Boomerang both, kill buffing followers before they scale, then grind the 190-HP priest with Uppercut/Unrelenting while blocking beam turns.
key_turns: Fear priest BEAM (~12, three hits) and turns both followers attack; block those. RITUAL buff turn and POWER_DANCE turns are free hits on followers.

summary: T1 The Bomb, Cruelty early; strip 8 Slippery with multi-hits; Bash+ then Setup Strike before Twin Strikes; full-block Dismember, dump damage on Prepare; exhaust Howl with Pact for free 18. Attack Potion early, Blood Potion emergency.
key_turns: DISMEMBER 27-30 plus 3 wounds: full block (Evil Eye+ after an exhaust, Shrug It Off, Defends). PREPARE buff turn: zero incoming, dump all attacks. INKY_LANCE ~15: block most.

summary: Race the parasite: Bash+ then Dismantle/attacks. On INFECT (no damage) turns go all-in; block only the 16-damage LASH turns. Save Stomp's AOE for the death spawns; Blood potion emergency only.
key_turns: INFECT turns (0 dmg): attack freely. LASH turns: cover ~16 block, no more. After elite dies it spawns frogs — hold Stomp/AOE for them.

summary: Race the spawned worms: one stunned turn to kill freely, then trade one kill per turn to cut the incoming 8s. Stomp finishes clusters; Blood Potion only if HP drops low.
key_turns: Now (all stunned): Bash+ then Dismantle kills one. When 3-4 bite (24-32), kill a worm each turn rather than block; use Stomp to finish 2+ at ≤13 HP.

summary: Byrdonis scales, so race: Setup Strike into Bash+ then Dismantle double-hits, Shrug It Off/Toric Toughness covering 17-18 attacks, kill by turn 4-5. Save heal potion.
key_turns: SWOOP 18 and later hits grow with its Strength; full-block each attack turn, burst on the other. Blood Potion only under ~20 HP.

summary: Race it: Rupture is dead (no self-damage) and Feel No Pain weak, skip both. Bash+ into Dismantle, Perfected Strike (21) for damage; push below 150 for the free stun; Blood potion only when low.
key_turns: Free buff turn now: Bash+ sets Vulnerable, then Dismantle doubles. PLOW turns (20-24) and post-stun STOMP/CRUSH (15-21): full block, Block potion if short. Stun turn free; RINGING turn: one big card.

summary: Inflame+ first for permanent +3 Strength, Bash+ for Vulnerable, then race with Sword Boomerang/Anger/Strikes. Razor Tooth upgrades each card played — play cheap cards early. Block big swings; save both potions for Vantom.
key_turns: T1 Inflame+; then Bash+ and burst while Vulnerable lasts. Incoming grows each turn (17→20+): full-block the 20+ swings, kill by T5.

summary: T1 Inflame+ while eating 7; strip 8 Slippery with Sword Boomerang/Twin/Anger; Bash+ for Vulnerable once hits land; block fully on Dismember, attack freely on Prepare; Regen on Dismember turn, Blood if low.
key_turns: T3 Dismember 27 + 3 wounds: full block (Blood Wall + Shrug). T4 Prepare: free turn, dump damage and strip Slippery. T2 Inky Lance 15: block.

summary: Deploy Inflame+ and Inferno turn 1 (free). Bash+ for vulnerable, then Bludgeon/Sword Boomerang; fully block turns 3 and 7. Regen turn 1, Blood Potion emergency. Kill before turn 10.
key_turns: T1 free: setup. T3/T7: 30+ multi-hit, full block and Colossus while Bash+ vulnerable. T2/T6: 19; T4/T8: 12 plus 30 heal. Stay above 35 HP before T7.

summary: Setup Inflame+/Inferno and Power Potion (Demon Form) on the block turn; Regen early covers self-damage. Skip artifact stripping. Attack on laser/buff turns, banking energy for double Bludgeon; Inferno procs from Blood Wall/Hemokinesis/Offe…
key_turns: T1/T4/T7 EBB: 33 block, play powers/block only. T2/T5 EYE_LASERS 22-29: block fully. T3/T6 buff turns: bank Ice Cream energy, unload double Bludgeon; kill before T9.

summary: Powers first (Inflame, Inferno), apply Bash+ vulnerable immediately, block big Dismember turn, then race: attack potion on burst turn; keep HP above 60% for Act 2.
key_turns: T3 Dismember 27 + 3 Wounds: block fully with Colossus + Shrug It Off; T4 Prepare (no attack): unload all damage; T1-2 strip 8 Slippery with Twin Strike/Bash+.

summary: Race 4 eels: Setup Strike then Stomp (Stomp costs 2, +3 Str = 15 AoE), kill lowest HP first, one Defend when ~19 incoming. Fysh Oil early; save HP for boss.
key_turns: T2-T3 each ~19 incoming (8+7+4): cover with one Defend (10 via Unmovable+) if it beats a Strike; buff turns are free; finish weakest before LASH 8s arrive.

summary: Turn 1: Power Potion (Demon Form/Inflame) plus Inferno and Unmovable+. Deal ~20 every turn under the hardened-shell cap, block the 14/15/18 attack turns, kill in 4-5 turns, keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: INERTIA turn (no attack): dump full 20 damage. PIERCING_STABS 18 turn: block fully with Unmovable+/Taunt/Defends; ZOOM 15 likewise. Never exceed ~20 damage/turn in one turn — wasted on the shell cap.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Unmovable+ and Inferno, block each CRASH with Taunt/Defend, chip with strikes; once near 70 HP burst on a CRASH turn to stun-cancel it, then finish before strength snowballs.
key_turns: CRASH turns (16-23): block fully. Burst it under 70 on a CRASH turn to cancel that attack (Setup Strike+Flex+Whirlwind). TERROR: free turn, set up.

summary: Race: no scaling left; enemy pressure and steam grow each turn. Turns 1-2 play Inferno + Unmovable+, stack Vulnerable, burn it down by ~turn 7, then full-block the EXPLODE.
key_turns: Block Pressure Gun (22→30) turns. Before lethal, Headbutt a Defend+/Taunt+ onto the draw pile; after ABOUT_TO_BLOW spend the whole turn blocking: EXPLODE ~33-36.

summary: Turns 1-2: Inferno then Unmovable+, blocking. Then race with Uppercut/Bash vulnerable, Whirlwind, Breakthrough (extra Inferno trigger). Thorns plus block on BEES; skill potion on a heavy-hit turn.
key_turns: Pheromone Spit (0 damage) is a free turn: powers/big attacks. BEES 3×7: thorns plus block each hit; SPEAR 18: one big block. Bees hits ~26+ after buff.

summary: Setup turns 1-2: Inferno, Unmovable+, Stone Armor while blocking. Then keep both claws' HP even, fully block the rocket's laser, and burst both claws down the same turn with Whirlwind/Stomp/Howl.
key_turns: Rocket's LASER (~45) around T3-4: bring full block via Unmovable+/Shrug. Keep both claws' HP even; killing one alone gives the other 99 block; finish both in one turn.

summary: Race the Eel: Bash then Dismantle for doubled vulnerable hits. Drop it below 70 HP in a single turn to stun and skip an attack. Keep HP and potions for the Waterfall Giant's self-destruct turn.
key_turns: Trigger SHRIEK under 70 HP in one turn to stun and cancel its attack; fully block CRASH 23 turns; after THRASH buff its hits grow, so don't stall.

summary: Race: Bash+ then Molten Fist, then Dismantle/Twin Strike burst. Shackling potion on the largest attack turn. After it dies, fully block the steam explosion (36+) and never sit below the steam stack count.
key_turns: Turn 1 Buff: Bash+ then Molten Fist for 6 vulnerable. Escalating Pressure Gun (20/25/30) and RAM/STOMP turns: block hard. Explode turn after its death: full block 36+; stay above steam stacks.

summary: T1 set up Inflame (+Inferno if drawn), then race: Bash for vulnerable, dump Twin Strike/Strikes, block with Shrug/Taunt keeping losses under ~10/turn, kill by turn 4. Save potions for the Kin boss.
key_turns: Intent climbs +1 Str/turn: 17, then 19, 21+. Block 8+ on peck/swoop turns and race to kill by turn 4; do not spend potions here.

summary: Play Inflame and Inferno turn 1, then race followers down with Binding potion for weak+vuln; block beam turns, keep HP above 40 for the rest of the act.
key_turns: ~25-damage turns (Beam + both followers): full block with Colossus+Taunt. Kill both followers by turn 4-6 before buffs stack; priest Ritual turn = free damage.

summary: Race: Bash then Breakthrough on turn 1 kills the 17 HP Wriggler and AoEs the rest. Drink Power Potion turn 1 for a free power. Kill one Wriggler per turn before their buffs stack up.
key_turns: WRIGGLE turns (only two bites, 6 each) are the safe turns: attack freely. Once bites reach 10+, kill the lowest-HP Wriggler each turn and block with leftovers.

summary: No powers to set up, so race the 62 HP elite: free INFECT turn dumps Bash+ and Molten Fist for 6 vulnerable, block the 16 LASH, then AOE the spawns after it dies. Keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: Turn 1 must be free (INFECT, 0 dmg): Bash+ then Molten Fist then all attacks. LASH turn hits 16: block it or kill first. Death-spawn turn: Breakthrough first, then Strikes on lowest HP.

summary: Pure race vs four ~19 HP Wrigglers: free stun turn for Breakthrough+ and Bash+, then delete the lowest-HP attacker each turn, blocking when 3+ bite. Keep HP for The Kin boss; no powers exist.
key_turns: T1 all stunned: no block, dump Breakthrough + Bash+. Turns 2-4: 24-32 incoming; kill one Wriggler per turn, block the rest; fear WRIGGLE buffs making bites 10+.

summary: Race the Effigy: use the two free turns (sleep, wake) for maximum damage — Bash+ then Molten Fist to stack 6 vulnerable, then all attacks (Slow rewards many cards per turn). Block 10-15 from T3; save HP for The Kin.
key_turns: T1 sleep and T2 wake are free: dump attacks, Bash+ then Molten Fist for 6 vulnerable. From T3 it slashes 23+ with rising strength — keep ~12 block up while racing, kill by T5-6.

summary: Race the 84 HP bird: Bash+ then Dominate turn 1, dump strikes through vulnerable, block only SWOOP hits. Kill in ~4 turns before strength stacks; save dexterity potion for the boss unless HP tanks.
key_turns: T1: Bash+ then Dominate (+4 STR on 4 vuln). T2-T3 (candlestick energy): all-out strikes. SWOOP turns 18-20: block if HP<55. Kill by ~T4 before TERRITORIAL strength stacks.

summary: Bash+ then Molten Fist on the 190 HP priest for 6 vulnerable, Dominate for +6 strength; Breakthrough/Stomp clear both followers first (kill left), then grind the priest while blocking.
key_turns: Priest's RITUAL turn (no attack): dump damage. Block hard on the following BEAM and on any follower turn right after POWER_DANCE buffs; incoming reaches ~20-30 mid-fight.

summary: Inferno makes every Breakthrough HP-loss deal 6 AOE; T1 vuln amplifies it. Keep segment HP even, then kill all three the same turn — any survivor reattaches at 25 HP. Incoming ~24/turn is minor; anchor plus a Defend suffices. Blood potions…
key_turns: T1 Inferno+Breakthroughs under Marble Bag vuln; T2 Inferno tick 6 AOE may finish all. Kill turn: Thunderclap (vuln) → Breakthroughs → Stomp+ (free) → Feed for a kill (+3 max HP).

summary: Inferno first, then Dominate and Stone Armor while Rocket charges. Spread damage to keep both claws' HP even, block heavy strikes, kill both in one turn; Blood Potions only at low HP.
key_turns: Rocket's charged LASER (45) and PRECISION_BEAM (27) turns: full block. Never solo-kill a claw (other gains 99 block, +6 str); keep HP even, finish both same turn.

summary: Set up Inferno+Pyre early, then chain Breakthroughs (each HP loss = 6 AOE to all knights). Kill MAGI_KNIGHT first to remove the 35 bomb; AOE handles the rest. Feed any knight that drops low; blood potions only if HP collapses.
key_turns: T1-2: Inferno then Pyre+ (gauntlet: powers +1). Block FLAIL 20/RAM 15 and MAGI's PREP into MAGIC_BOMB 35; full block that turn.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Inferno then Pyre+; each Breakthrough then deals 11 + 6 Inferno damage. Fully block the 42 cleave and Flamethrower; Feed for max HP. Blood Potions only under 45 HP.
key_turns: WINDUP (0 dmg): play Pyre/Stone Armor, dump Breakthroughs. HEAVY_CLEAVE 42: full block, Flame Barrier+. Strip Artifact (Uppercut, Thunderclap) before Bash+; then Colossus halves damage.

summary: Open Inferno then Pyre+; phase 1 attack-only to skip Enrage strength. Use the free Respawn turn for setup. Race phase 2 before Multi-Claw outgrows block; in phase 3 burst only when Intangible is absent.
key_turns: Phase1 avoid Skills (Enrage strength); Respawn turn is free — play Pyre/powers and block. Phase2 claws grow 30/40/50/60: race in 4 turns. Phase3 attack only on non-Intangible turns.

summary: Race the elite: use two free turns for maximum damage and Vulnerable, then block ~23 per turn with Shrug/Defends while still attacking. Hemokinesis costs only 1 HP thanks to Tungsten Rod; Fairy Bottle is the emergency net.
key_turns: T1-T2 free (Sleep then Wake): dump every attack, Bash for Vulnerable, play cheap cards first to ramp Slow. T3+ Slashes 23/turn: Shrug plus Defends block, remainder attacks; keep HP >20.

summary: Race: Offering turn 1 followed by Blessing to upgrade the whole hand, strip Slippery with multi-hits, Bash for Vulnerable, hard-block every Dismember, and unload damage on Prepare turns; Fairy covers mistakes.
key_turns: T1-2 strip all 8 Slippery with Twin Strike/Boomerang; T3 Dismember 27+3 wounds: full block, no greed; T4 Prepare: Setup Strike then multi-hit burst.

summary: Kill Rock then Silk by turn 3 while dropping Battle Trance/Unmovable; never poke the sleeping beetle (15 Plating blocks small hits). When it wakes, block its 19+ rolls with Unmovable-boosted Shrugs, burst under Bash+ vulnerability, Weak po…
key_turns: T1-3: kill Rock then Silk; leave beetle asleep. T4+: beetle ROLL_OUT ~19+ (stunned the turn you wake it) — block with Unmovable+Shrug, burst under Bash+.

summary: Race with Inflame then Offering/Battle Trance; focus BACK segment, let Shuriken and Baking Glove build strength, block the ~24+/turn, hold Fairy as death insurance and Swift for the finishing turn.
key_turns: Turn 3 (Chandelier energy) is the first burst window. After any BULK, attacks hit ~30+: block fully, don't trade HP. Burst BACK before strength stacks; finish segments in one turn.

summary: Race the sandpit clock: Frantic Escape extends it, never exhaust those cards. Inflame+Unmovable turn 1; Baking Glove/Shuriken stack strength for a late burst. Block the 29/21 hits; free turns are pure damage. Fairy is the net.
key_turns: T1 free: Inflame/Unmovable/Offering. Land 29 and 21 turns: block hard; zero-damage LIQUIFY/SALIVATE turns: all-in damage. Sandpit ≤2: Frantic Escape before attacking; Swift digs for it.

summary: T1 Demon Form, then Unmovable+; strip Artifact 3 with Bag/Taunt/Bash before relying on Vulnerable. Turns 2/5/8 (33 block) are setup/block turns only; ramp strength and kill by turn 8.
key_turns: Our turns 2/5/8: Ebb's 33 block is up — play powers/block, no attacks. Fear Ebb 22 and Eye Lasers 22+; block fully, kill by turn 8.

summary: Race: open Thunderclap for AOE+vuln, then focus-fire the weakest Wriggler each turn; kills stop bites and Wriggle strength/status. Block just enough to stay above ~50 HP; Juggernaut once on a light turn.
key_turns: T1: Thunderclap first for vuln, then burst lowest-HP. Kill one Wriggler every turn. From T3 stacked strength makes bites 10+; keep a Defend up. Juggernaut only on buff-only turns.

summary: Juggernaut turn 1 while INFECT deals nothing; block the 16-damage LASH turns, kill the parasite by T4-5, and hold AOE (Thunderclap, Breakthrough) for the worms spawned on its death.
key_turns: T1/T3 INFECT deal no damage: attack freely. T2/T4 LASH 16: fully block with True Grit + Defends. After it dies 4 worms spawn: Thunderclap/Breakthrough + Juggernaut clears them.

summary: Four stunned vulnerable worms: sweep them fastest with AOE plus focused kills on the weakest; each dead worm removes 8 damage per bite turn. Winnable on cards — hold both potions for the Kin boss.
key_turns: Now all stunned: free turn, kill lowest-HP worms first (17/18/19/21). Bite turns: 8 per living worm; block if 3+ alive. WRIGGLE turns deal 0: dump damage.

summary: Play Juggernaut on the free sleep turn; then grind: block each SLASHES (~23), chip with Juggernaut triggers, burst in the Bash+ into Molten Fist vuln window. Keep HP above ~30; Blood Potion only if low.
key_turns: SLASHES 23 can repeat back-to-back — block fully every turn, no greedy turns. After Bash+, Molten Fist doubles vuln to 6; dump all attacks plus Cure All that turn.

summary: Race: focus AoE and attacks to kill both followers within ~4 turns, then grind Priest. Bash+/Molten Fist (plus Vulnerable potion) on Priest for doubled Vulnerable; hold blocks for BEAM and buffed-Orb turns.
key_turns: Ramp turns (Power Dance, Ritual) are the fear; kill both followers by turn ~4 with AoE, then all-in Priest; block BEAM 13+ and big Orbs; Juggernaut only on no-attack turns.

summary: Turtle at 13 HP: block 14-18 every turn, BASH+ then COLOSSUS to halve a big hit, dump damage on the no-attack INERTIA turn. Powdered Demise early; Skill Potion only to block a lethal turn.
key_turns: Now 14; next turn INERTIA buff (no attack) — free turn for full damage. Then PIERCING_STABS 18 and ZOOM 15: full block, Colossus. 13 HP: never eat an unblocked hit.

summary: Turn 1 BECKON: Juggernaut+Inferno+Bloodletting (Centennial Puzzle draw, 6 free Inferno damage). Retain Serum early. Halve DE_GAS with Bash+Colossus, never attack into FADE, grind 211 HP, exit above half.
key_turns: DE_GAS 21: Bash+ then Colossus halves it; FADE turn: fish intangible, no attacks, block/draw; SCREAM 13 block. BECKON turns: play powers/setup.

summary: Setup engine T1-2: Inferno + Crimson Mantle + Juggernaut (~12 dmg and 7 block per turn for 2 HP). Then Bash+/Molten Fist+ for vulnerable; Colossus + Defends halve and block Pounce. Kill by T7.
key_turns: Pounce turns (~20; 30 if we are vulnerable): Bash+ then Colossus to halve, block fully. Curl Up soaks 14 of our first attack turn. Finish by T7.

summary: T1 is free: play Inferno, Crimson Mantle, Juggernaut (~12 chip/turn plus blocks). Bash+ then Colossus on big hits; Setup Strike chains for burst turns. Keep damage ahead of its 30-heal every 4 turns.
key_turns: T2 slap 19: full block. T3 overwhelming 30: Bash+/Taunt for vulnerable, then Colossus halves it; Speed Potion here. T4 ponder 12+heal 30: push damage. T5/T9 curses: play remaining powers.

summary: Set up Inferno+ and Crimson Mantle turn 1 (Juggernaut next) for 18-27 chip AOE per turn. Kill Magi Knight first, then Spectral. Save Blessing potion for the Queen burst.
key_turns: MAGIC_BOMB 35 lands ~T4: have Magi dead, or hold Colossus+Taunt with big block. WAR_CHANT/HEX/DAMPEN turns are free damage windows; FLAIL 20 turns need full block.

summary: Turns 1-2 are free: powers up, AOE both. Kill TORCH_HEAD_AMALGAM first, blocking its 18-26 hits; don't attack Queen while she has 20 block. Then grind her 400 with Juggernaut chip, Colossus for 45/26 turns, potions on burst.
key_turns: T1-2 no attack: dump AoE and powers. Block Amalgam's 26/18/8x3 hits fully. Once it dies, Queen cycles 45 Head-off then 26 Execution: have Colossus+Taunt up.

summary: Race Byrdonis before strength stacks: Stone Armor early, Bash for vulnerable, then Twin Strike/Setup Strike/Headbutt all-in. Defend only enough to survive big hits, keeping HP for the boss run.
key_turns: All turns are single attacks (17, then 18+) rising with strength. Turns 4+: pecks hit 21+; kill by turn 4-5, blocking Swoop turns to near zero.

summary: Race both followers: three-attack turns for Shuriken strength (Setup Strike+ first, then free Stomp), Stone Armor on a low-damage turn, block Beam turns, then grind the 190 HP priest with Bash vulnerable.
key_turns: Priest RITUAL turn: play Stone Armor. BEAM and post-Ritual buffed turns: full block. Kill followers before their POWER_DANCE strength stacks.

summary: Race one segment at a time: kill the middle, then its 25-HP reattach, then the next; AoE chips all three. Land Demon Form turns 1-2 and Stone Armor early. Full block on WRITHE turns.
key_turns: All-three WRITHE turns (~35 incoming): block fully. After a kill the segment's reattach turn is free — play Demon Form/Setup Strike then. Kill the middle first, then its 25-HP reattach.

summary: 逐只集火幽灵鳗，最大伤害牌先打（胆小格挡第一击后才加），残血优先斩杀；复制药水前两回合配痛击/预备打击爆发；多敌来攻先挡足再换血。
key_turns: 四只同时进攻或多段 1×3 的回合先挡满；Enlarge 后最危险，残血鳗优先斩杀防止它继续成长。

summary: No attacks while she sleeps: set up Hello World and Feel No Pain, keep HP. Once awake, Bash for vulnerable, block the 21/18 turns, burst on the Siphon turn, and kill before Siphon stacks twice.
key_turns: Sleep T1-3: powers only, no damage (plating eats chip; early wake wastes free turns). Wake: Bash+vulnerable burst. Block the 21 and 9x2 turns; dump damage on the Soul Siphon (no-attack) turn.

summary: Race the 135 HP Progenitor: Ember Tea strength, Bash then Molten Fist for 4 vulnerable, multi-hits with Setup Strike, block the 20-damage Pounces, take the 9+debuff hits; finish in ~5 turns.
key_turns: Buff turns (T2, T5) deal no damage: attack freely. POUNCE 20 turns (T3, T6): block fully with Blood Wall/Evil Eye; Curl-Up 14 wastes one hit, so lead with the biggest attack.

summary: Kill Rock first (15/turn), Silk second, using the beetle's 3 sleep turns; ignore the sleeping beetle meanwhile. Then 1v1: attack the beetle every turn so its 15 plating never builds up, blocking the 19s.
key_turns: T1-2: only Rock attacks, race it. T3-4 beetle wakes (Roll Out 19 + buff): have Rock+Silk dead, block hard. Then hit beetle every turn.

summary: Race with vulnerable since deck has no permanent strength: play Hello World on the free turn 1. Bash then Molten Fist doubles vulnerable, Setup Strike before Twin Strike. Fully block the slap and overwhelm; curse turns are pure damage.
key_turns: T2 slap 19 and T3/T7 overwhelm 30: block fully first, no greedy damage. T1/T5/T9 curse turns deal no damage - dump all offense. Bash before Molten Fist (vuln 2->4), Setup Strikes before Twin Strike.

summary: Race the bird: Inferno turn 1, Bash+ for vulnerable, Setup Strike into Whirlwind+ burst; block the SWOOP turns and kill by turn 4-5. Beetle Juice early to blunt the growing hits, Vulnerable Potion on the burst turn.
key_turns: No idle turns: 15-18+ attack every turn, growing with strength. Block SWOOP turns (Expect a Fight after Setup Strike = 30 block). Finish by turn 4-5 before hits exceed 25.

summary: Inferno turn 1; Setup Strike+ then Whirlwind+ for big AOE, killing both followers first by ~turn 4. Bash+ the priest, block BEAM turns, let Inferno ticks grind the 190 HP priest.
key_turns: T2-3: priest BEAM 13 plus follower attacks — full block. Priest RITUAL turn is free damage. Followers grow via POWER_DANCE; kill both by ~T4.

summary: Hardened Shell caps its HP loss near 20/turn, so this is a 4+ turn grind: Inflame on the free INERTIA turn, Bash+Colossus on the 18-hit turn, block the 14-15 hits, Orichalcum covers light turns; enter boss near full HP.
key_turns: Next turn INERTIA (no attack): play Inflame and hit freely. PIERCING_STABS 18: Bash first, then Colossus halves it. ZOOM 15/14 turns: Blood Wall plus Defend.

summary: Keep HP above steam stacks while racing. Free T1: Inflame, then Bash vulnerable doubled by Molten Fist; then Dismantle/Twin Strike damage. Colossus + Blood Wall on Pressure Gun/Stomp. Fully block final EXPLODE (~33-45).
key_turns: T1 buff = free setup: Inflame, Bash, Molten Fist. Siphon/buff turns: push damage. Pressure Gun 22→25→30 and Stomp: Colossus + Blood Wall. ABOUT_TO_BLOW: bank full block for EXPLODE ~33-45.

summary: Set up strength first: Inflame and Bash on turn 1, then Molten Fist into Dominate for huge vulnerable. Race it down before Curl and Grow stacks, full block on Pounce turns; Attack Potion only if it turns bad.
key_turns: T1: Inflame then Bash pops Curl Up; stop attacking after. T2: Molten Fist then Dominate (5+ strength). Pounce turns: Defends plus Colossus; block fully when Pounce is 25+.

summary: Bash, Molten Fist, then Dominate on Rock for ~5 permanent Strength and 5 vulnerable; kill Rock then Silk; play Inflame early; leave the sleeping beetle alone until both bugs are dead, then burst it.
key_turns: Keep beetle asleep (15 plating: hits under that don't wake it) while killing both bugs; block the wake turn's 19 Roll Out plus remaining bug attacks.

summary: Race 321 HP: on free turns play Bash+ → Molten Fist → Dominate (~+6 Str) and Inflame; keep boss vulnerable for Dismantle/Colossus; multi-hit attacks; block 18-29 hits; never let sandpit reach 0.
key_turns: Sandpit ≤2: play Frantic Escape before attacking. 29-damage LUNGING_BITE turns: Colossus+block; Speed Potion with block in hand. Attack Potion on our burst/finish turn.

summary: Setup Inflame turns 1-2 while partly blocking; Artifact 3 makes vulnerable unreliable — stop chasing it. Use free WINDUP turns for damage, fully block ~45 HEAVY_CLEAVE turns, retain block with Stable Serum.
key_turns: T3 WINDUP (no attack): burst and play Dark Embrace. T4 CLEAVE ~45: full block via double Blood Wall + Shrug, Serum-retained. Every later CLEAVE full block; race on FLAMETHROWER/WINDUP turns.

summary: Race Byrdonis before strength stacks: Bash+ into Molten Fist doubles vulnerable, then free Bully+ (~22). Spend spare energy on Defends to blunt the 17/18 hits. No potions; finish in ~3 turns, keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: It attacks 15/18 every turn and gains strength; block adequately with Defends. Land the vulnerable combo Bash+ → Molten Fist → Bully+ on turns 1–2.

summary: Race: burst the parasite by turn 2 (INFECT turns cost no HP), then drink Binding when the larvae spawn and clear them fast. Keep Liquid Memories unless HP drops near 45; rest site follows.
key_turns: T1 free: Bash+, Molten Fist, Bully+ (vuln x6, ~42 dmg). T2 finish before LASH. Larvae spawn: drink Binding (Weak+Vuln all) and burst them down; block heavy swarm turns.

summary: Race this elite: all four Wrigglers are stunned at 15-20 HP. Kill one per turn starting with the weakest (each kill cuts 8 incoming), block only when bites land. Save Liquid Memories for the boss.
key_turns: All four are stunned now: skip block, full burst; Bash+→Bully+ kills one, Molten Fist another. Then each turn kill the weakest first (each kill cuts 8 damage) and block the rest — up to 32 incoming.

summary: Vulnerable-burst race: strip Slippery with multi-hits, Bash+ then Molten Fist doubles vulnerability, Bully+ cashes it; block only Dismember fully, eat small hits, use Fysh Oil early and Liquid Memories on Prepare burst; finish before wound…
key_turns: T1-2 strip Slippery with Twin Strike/Sword Boomerang, Bash+ then Molten Fist (6 vuln). T3/T7 Dismember 27-31: full block. T4/T8 Prepare: all-in burst; Pen Nib fires after Slippery.

summary: Play Inflame/Pyre/Ritual in the first two turns while blocking. Chip the three segments evenly, then kill all three in one turn (Reattach 25). Use both potions on that burst turn.
key_turns: Constrict stacks; don't let the fight run long. Around turn 4-6, with Glove/Inflame strength up, pop both potions and Howl+attacks to kill all three the same turn.

summary: Establish Pyre+ and Inflame while safe, then ramp Baking Glove strength and doubled Vulnerable (Bash+ → Molten Fist → Dominate) into Bully+/Dismantle burst; block the 29-hit turns and never let Sandpit reach 0.
key_turns: Free turns T1/T4 (no attack): play Pyre+ and both Inflames. LUNGING_BITE 29 (T3) and 21 (T5): full block with Colossus/Shrugs. Sandpit ≤2: Frantic Escape first.

summary: Long elite: stack permanent Strength (Baking Glove, Inflame+, Pyre+) while safe, strip Artifact with cheap debuffs, land Bash+/Molten Fist vulnerable, then Bully+/Dismantle/Twin Strike burst; keep HP for Queen.
key_turns: T1 Apotheosis, then Pyre+/Inflame+; WINDUP turn is free — play powers; HEAVY_CLEAVE (~42) turn: Colossus + full block; strip Artifact 3 with Uppercut/Dominate before Bash+/Molten Fist.

summary: Set up: Apotheosis T1, stack Inflames and Pyre in the two debuff-free turns; dump AoE/big hits then. After You Are Mine, all attacks on Amalgam with Molten Fist/Bash to double Vulnerable; survive Queen's offensive phase.
key_turns: T1: Apotheosis plus block the 26 tackle. T2: last debuff-free turn — play Inflames/Pyre/AoE. T3+: 99 Vulnerable/Weak/Frail, kill Amalgam. Then fear Queen's 7x5 and Execution 25.

summary: Full HP vs 183: play Unmovable/Stone Armor early, strip Slippery with multi-hits (Fysh Oil first for per-hit Strength), block Dismember fully, burst on Prepare turns with Attack Potion; race before wounds clog.
key_turns: DISMEMBER turns (27 + 3 wounds): full block, save Expect a Fight for these. PREPARE: no attack, dump damage/powers. Strip 9 Slippery with Whirlwind/multi-hit before big single hits.

summary: T1 is free: Inflame, then race. Block Gun/Ram/Stomp, burst through Siphon heals, Gigantify a vulnerable Uppercut, kill fast so the explosion stays blockable.
key_turns: T1 buff: play Inflame. Block Pressure Gun (22->30), Stomp, Ram turns. Siphon heals 10 - dump damage after. Keep Defend/Expect a Fight for the final EXPLODE (~30+).

summary: Play Rupture then Inferno early while blocking; 6 AOE per turn plus strength grind all four down. Focus one Gardener at a time, biggest hit first vs Skittish block; save HP for the boss.
key_turns: T1-2 take ~15: block while playing powers. After ENLARGE buffs land, incoming spikes — Weak Potion plus full block. Biggest attack first vs Skittish 7.

summary: Open Rupture then Inferno while it buffs, so every self-damage card gives Strength and 6 AOE. Then race: block the escalating guns, and keep HP above steam stacks for the explosion turn.
key_turns: First turn is free (buff): play both powers. Pressure Gun turns (20/25/30) block heavily. When it drops to 0, next turn is EXPLODE: full block, never attack the husk.

summary: Engine fight at 17 HP: scale Rupture+Inferno+Demon Form while blocking every attack; grow strength so Expect a Fight covers the 20+ POUNCEs, then burst with Bash+ into Molten Fist. Drink Snake Oil turns 1-2.
key_turns: T1: block 9, play Inferno+/Rupture. T2: no attack—play Demon Form+. T3/T6: POUNCE 20+, full block with Flame Barrier/Expect a Fight. Finisher: Bash+ then Molten Fist.

summary: Powers first: Demon Form+ and Rupture down by turn 2, Inferno+ right after, blocking the 21/18/26 hits. Then race with big single hits before Dazed flood; stay above 60 HP for Knowledge Demon.
key_turns: PHEROMONE_SPIT (no attack) is the Demon Form+ slot; block heavy on the 3×7 and 26 BEES turns, Ship in a Bottle if HP drops; end it fast, every attack adds Dazed.

summary: Powers first (Demon Form+, Rupture, Inferno+), then block the ~24/turn cycle while AOE chips all segments evenly and single-target hits the 52 HP head. Once strength is high, kill all three in one turn so none reattaches.
key_turns: BULK/WRITHE turns hit ~24 and grow; block them, use Colossus+Taunt vs vulnerable. Save Breakthrough/AOE for the turn all three sit near 25 HP; kill them together.

summary: Use the beetle's 3 sleep turns: Demon Form+ then Rupture/Inferno+, killing the Rock bug first. Block the ~23/turn, then blunt the woken beetle's 19+ with Colossus/vulnerable and scale to finish it.
key_turns: Turns 1-3 while beetle sleeps: kill Rock bug first, powers down. T4 beetle wakes with ROLL_OUT 19+buff: full block or Colossus+Taunt; Speed potion if incoming ≥25.

summary: Turn 1 curse is free: Demon Form+ then Rupture (4 energy). Inferno+ turn 2, then Bash-vulnerable into big attacks; keep HP by blocking the 30-damage turns. Fire Potion only as emergency burst.
key_turns: T2 Slap 19, T3/T7/T11 multi-hit ~30: full block (Expect a Fight, Flame Barrier, Colossus). T1/T5/T9 curse turns: play powers, free damage. Never skip blocking to chip.

summary: Opening two turns are free: play Inflame then Inferno. Race the beast below 150 HP for the free stun; block 20-24 PLOW turns fully; on RINGING turns play one big card; use potions on big hits.
key_turns: T1-2 free (no attack): play powers. Block fully on PLOW 20/22/24 and CRUSH; drop below 150 to trigger free stun; RINGING turn plays only one biggest card.

summary: Hardened Shell caps our damage near 20/turn, so chip steadily while blocking the 18, 15 and 14 hits; use the no-attack INERTIA turn for free damage and keep HP for the run.
key_turns: Next turn INERTIA (no attack): attack freely. Following PIERCING_STABS 18: Flame Barrier plus full block, Skill Potion if short. Then ZOOM 15 and 14 turns: block each fully.

summary: Race the eel: Bash up vulnerable, Setup Strike plus One-Two Punch for burst, block CRASH hits with Flame Barrier. Push it below half HP early for its stun turn. Keep the potion for Soul Fysh unless dying here.
key_turns: T3+: Shiny Lipstick +1 Str/Dex, dump damage. Cross below 75 HP early to trigger the eel's STUN free turn. On CRASH (16-22) turns, full block with Flame Barrier.

summary: Turn 1 Inflame (no attack incoming), Bash for vulnerable, stack Setup Strike strength, then burst with One-Two Punch plus Perfected/Pommel Strike. Burn Beckons with Burning Pact and True Grit; never attack into Intangible; keep HP for the …
key_turns: T1 Beckon: Inflame. Full block on the 21 (DE_GAS) and 13 (SCREAM) attack turns. On FADE/Intangible turns: no attacks — exhaust Beckons with Pact/Grit, play powers, block.

summary: Race 221 HP before Beckons stack. T1 Inflame then Bash+ for strength and 3 vulnerable; burst with Whirlwind/Twin Strike on full-damage turns; block DE_GAS 21 and SCREAM 13 fully. Expect ~10 turns.
key_turns: T2/T7 DE_GAS 21: full block. T4/T9 pre-FADE: dump attacks. T5/T10 intangible SCREAM 13: block, vuln/utility only. Beckons = 6 unblockable each; end fast.

summary: Inflame, then double Inferno for 12 AOE per Breakthrough/Blood Wall, Demon Form early; block BEES turns; Strength potion on a Whirlwind burst; kill before Pheromone scaling.
key_turns: BEES turns (3×7, grows each Pheromone cycle): block to near zero. Pheromone buff turns: play powers. Kill by ~turn 7 before BEES exceeds 30.

summary: Turn 1 Demon Form is free behind Anchor; then Inferno and Inflame, and let Breakthrough/Blood Wall self-damage trigger Inferno for big damage. Keep HP up for the crab.
key_turns: POUNCE 20 turn: block it fully. Curl Up 18 absorbs the first attack, so lead with Whirlwind/Twin Strike. Stay high HP for Kaiser Crab.

summary: Setup Demon Form, Inflame and Inferno turns 1-3, chip both claws evenly with AOE (Breakthrough, Whirlwind, Bomb), block hard on Laser/Precision turns, then kill both claws the same turn to avoid Crab Rage.
key_turns: Rocket CHARGE_UP/RECHARGE: attack freely; following LASER 45/Precision 27: full block, Dexterity potion. Keep both claws even, above ~15 HP; finish both in one burst (Whirlwind+Bomb).

summary: Rupture turn 1, then Breakthrough each turn to feed Strength. Break 9 Slippery with cheap multi-hits, then Bash+ into Dismantle. Fortifier on the first Dismember; protect HP since the run continues.
key_turns: Dismember (~27 + 3 wounds) every 4th turn: full block, Fortifier. PREPARE turns: attack freely. Strip 9 Slippery with Whirlwind/Strikes before landing Bash+/Dismantle.

summary: At 22 HP: block every turn, chip all segments evenly with Breakthrough AOE, set Rupture then Pyre, drink both potions now, finish all three segments in one turn.
key_turns: WRITHE turns (~37 damage): full block plus Flame Barrier. Kill all three segments in one turn; isolated kills reattach at 25 HP.

summary: Race: turn 1 Inferno+ (9 dmg/turn for 1 energy), then Bash+ into Molten Fist+ (vulnerable doubled) and Pommel Strikes. Block each 17-18 hit, use Speed Potion only if a turn turns lethal-ish; Byrdonis scales every turn, so no turtling.
key_turns: All turns hit 17-18+ and grow with strength: kill by turn 4. Turn 1 play Inferno+; block SWOOP turns with Shrug It Off and Defends, never dip under ~30 HP.

summary: Setup: Inferno+ and Inflame on the opening buff turns, then Bash+ into Molten Fist+; Breakthrough feeds Inferno for 18/turn. Block every Plow, burst under 150 for the free stun, Blood Potion on the Ringing turn.
key_turns: Plow 22–24: full block. Cross 150 on a buff turn for the stun; Ampoule helps. Ringing turn: one card only — best block, drink Blood Potion.

summary: Play Inferno+ and Inflames early behind blocks; race with Breakthrough/Brand (each self-damage triggers Inferno for 9) and single big hits like Molten Fist+ and Bash+; avoid multi-hit attacks (Whirlwind, Sword Boomerang), which feed Dazed.
key_turns: Turns 1-2 (BEES 3×7, then SPEAR 18) block hard while playing Inferno+/Inflames; the buff turn is free damage; never let a second BEES cycle land.

summary: Powers first (Inferno+, Inflames) during the beetle's sleep; race bowlbugs with AoE, Rock first; then burst the beetle, blocking its rolls. Blood Potions emergency-only; keep one for Kaiser Crab.
key_turns: Beetle wakes once AoE breaks its 18 plating (~T2); that turn is stunned/free, then full-block its ~19-25 rolls. Kill Rock by T3; Blood Potion if HP <25.

summary: Powers first (Inferno+, Inflames) behind blocks; Breakthrough/Brand trigger Inferno for double AoE. Keep claws even, finish both in one turn with Flex potion burst; block Rocket's 45 LASER.
key_turns: Rocket CHARGE_UP turn = free setup/attack; next turn LASER 45 — stack full block plus Uppercut weak. Keep both claws even; never solo-kill one (99 block +6 Str).

summary: Shell caps damage at 20/turn, so no racing: block the 14/18/15/14 cycle, dump full damage on the buff turn, play Forgotten Ritual/Taunt early to charge Evil Eye and hit the cap. Save potions for Soul Fysh.
key_turns: Now 14, then T3 PIERCING_STABS 18 is the spike — full block; T4 15, T5 14. T2 INERTIA: no attack, dump damage. Never waste damage past the 20 shell cap.

summary: Bash/Taunt vuln on free Beckon turns, block the 21 and 13 hits fully, skip damage while intangible; grind 221 HP with Anger/Headbutt and Setup Strike bursts, Feed finisher for +3 max HP; spend both potions if needed.
key_turns: T2/T7 DE_GAS 21: full block. T4 FADE: intangible—play Ritual/block, don't attack. T5 SCREAM 13: block. Don't over-draw into Beckons.

summary: Grind, don't race: Pyre+ in the first two turns, block every attack, kill in ~7-8 turns. Lead each turn with your biggest attack so curl-up's 18 block eats less. Keep HP >=55 for the road to the Insatiable boss.
key_turns: WEB_CANNON (9+debuff): block with one card. CURL_AND_GROW = free turn: Pyre+ then attacks. POUNCE 20: full block (Shrug+/Evil Eye after True Grit). Drink VULN potion turn 1-2 with Bash+.

summary: Pyre+ and Brand early while blocking; chip all three evenly, never killing one alone. Around turn 4-5, Binding Potion plus Whirlwind/Stomp/Bash+ kills all three together; preserve HP for the boss.
key_turns: No solo kills (segments revive at 25). Turns 3-5: BULK stacks, attacks 30+; block fully, save Impervious. Kill turn: Binding Potion + Bash+/Whirlwind/Stomp kills all three together.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Pyre+, then Inferno/Brand; block every Thrash/Lunge, extend the sand clock with Escapes, then burst under Marble Bag vulnerability plus Flex.
key_turns: Sandpit ≤2: play Frantic Escape before attacking; 0 = death. Full-block LUNGING_BITE 29 (Impervious/Shrug+ draws). Liquify Ground and Salivate buffs are free turns for powers and attacks.

summary: Set up Inferno on the free INFECT turn, block every 16 LASH, Bash+ then burst the parasite down; save Whirlwind and Breakthrough to wipe the spawn wave that erupts on its death.
key_turns: T1/T3 INFECT are free: play Inferno, then unload. T2/T4 LASH 16: full block. On parasite death a spawn wave appears: hold Whirlwind/Breakthrough for it.

summary: Wrigglers spawned stunned — free burst turn. Inferno plus double Breakthrough (15 AoE each, self-damage feeds Inferno) and Whirlwind should wipe all four before their bites; clean leftovers with Bash+/Dismantle, keep HP for the boss.
key_turns: Free turn now (all stunned): Inferno, double Breakthrough, Whirlwind. Next turn each survivor bites 8: finish them with single-target attacks, block only if 3+ live.

summary: T1 Inferno so every HP loss (Breakthrough, Inferno tick) becomes 6 AoE. Kill both followers with Breakthrough/Whirlwind AoE first, Flex potion early to speed it. Then Bash+ and Dismantle the priest, Vulnerable potion on the burst turn, blo…
key_turns: Followers BUFF (POWER_DANCE) each cycle — AoE them together before attacks scale. Priest BEAM 13×3 every 4 turns: full block. Weak/frail orbs cut our damage — Bash+ to re-apply vulnerable.

summary: Turn 1 Inferno + Unmovable+; AoE (Breakthrough/Whirlwind/Howl) kills Rock then Silk while beetle sleeps. Then Bash+ and burst beetle down, blocking its 19+ hits. Keep Radiant Tincture for The Insatiable race.
key_turns: Silk's Toxic Spit debuff turn; beetle wakes ~T3-4 with ROLL_OUT 19+buff — have Colossus+/Shrug block ready, don't wake it early.

summary: Race the sandpit clock: Inferno and Unmovable+ on the free first turn, Bash+ keeps vulnerable, Colossus+ neuters the 29/21 bites, Baking Glove ramps strength, then burst with Flex + Setup Strike+ + Whirlwind. Breakthrough procs Inferno eac…
key_turns: T1 free: powers. 29 LUNGING_BITE/21 THRASH_MOVE_2: Colossus+ plus full block. SALIVATE/buff turns: max damage. Keep Bash+ vulnerable, Flex+Setup Strike+ into Whirlwind burst.

summary: Race the ~8-turn clock: T1 Inferno, Rolling Boulder, Unmovable+; dump Bludgeon/Setup/Howl on unblocked turns; block laser turns; True Grit+/Baking Glove eat Withers; Heart of Iron potion early.
key_turns: T2/T5/T8: enemy holds 33 block — no attacks, play powers/block. Burst on T1/T3/T4/T6/T7. Block EYE_LASERS 29 (T2/T5) fully; Bash first if Weak is to land.

summary: Pure race vs a 42 HP normal monster: Bash then Strikes/Twin Strike, never play Barricade (3 energy, useless here). Accept the 8-damage debuff turn, block the 12 slam, save both potions for the Soul Fysh boss.
key_turns: Only one enemy, 42 HP: kill by turn 3-4. Take the opening 8 + debuff, fully block the 12 SLAM turn; if it buffs, burst before attacks scale.

summary: Race two ~25 HP Toadpoles: Bash a target then Dismantle it (32, kills turn 1), repeat on the other. Block only the 9 Spike Spit. Skip Barricade; save both potions for elite/boss.
key_turns: Focus the 26 HP Toadpole (attacks next turn) first: Bash then Dismantle for 32, kills it. Then Spike Spit 9 comes; block or kill. Never play Barricade.

summary: Race the clam: Inflame early, block the Jet turns with Shrug It Off, dump damage on PRESSURIZE. Bash then Dismantle burst through the 9 Plating. Save both potions for the boss; never play Barricade.
key_turns: Jet turns (10-13 dmg): block first with Shrug It Off/Defends, then attack. PRESSURIZE (0 dmg): full damage dump. Plating 9 eats chip hits — land Bash/Dismantle burst, not solo Strikes.

summary: Race the 52 HP merc: Bash for vulnerable, then Dismantle/Twin Strikes for 24+/turn. At 70 HP take one 16 hit; avoid GIMME gold steal by killing fast. Keep Barricade and potions for later.
key_turns: Kill by T2-3: Bash then Dismantle (24). If not lethal, block the 16 GIMME. Never play Barricade.

summary: Inflame on the free turn, then race its 60 HP with Bash+/Twin Strike; block the 10 and 14 attack turns with Shrug It Off. Both potions saved for Soul Fysh. Enter boss near full.
key_turns: T1 READY deals 0: play Inflame free. T3 STRONG_PUNCH 14: full block. Artifact eats Bash's vulnerable, so Dismantle stays 8 damage.

summary: Race: kill the summoning rat first (no backup), then the other two, blocking the 8-attacks; Inflame only when the hand still kills; never Barricade; save both potions for the boss.
key_turns: T1 kill the summon-intent rat (Bash+ then Dismantle) or a 4th rat joins; while 2+ live expect 14+/turn, block the 8-attack; after any Screech their hits grow — finish fast.

summary: Both cultists buff T1 — free setup turn: Inflame then Bash+ the Calcified (40 HP, hits 10). Burst it by T3, then Damp; ritual strength makes this a fast race. Keep potions for the fish boss.
key_turns: T1 both buff — free: play Inflame, Bash+ the Calcified. T2–T5 DARK_STRIKE grows ~3/turn (≈23→30): finish Calcified, then Damp, or block 25+.

summary: Race: Inflame then Bash+ turn 1; block the 21 and 13 hits, burst with vulnerable-boosted Dismantle/Twin Strike on free turns; kill before Beckons pile up; Touch of Insanity on Bash+; skip Barricade.
key_turns: T2 DE_GAS 21 and T5 SCREAM 13: full block. T4 FADE/intangible: no attacks, block or power. Burst T3/T6 while vulnerable lasts.

summary: Race the hopper: Inflame then Bash+ early, Dismantle/Twin Strike/Headbutt into the vulnerability, Shrug It Off for the 17-21 hits; kill it before ESCAPE fires or it escapes with stolen cards permanently.
key_turns: Escape clock ~5: it steals a card each attack, kill by turn 4-5. Block 17/21 with Shrug It Off; save Impervious unless HP <45.

summary: Inflame T1; focus the nectar bug with Bash+/Dismantle while chipping the rock. Play attacks before Stomp to discount it, then Whirlwind with leftover energy; keep HP for the crab boss.
key_turns: T3 if both alive: 15+18 incoming — block or kill. Play attacks before Stomp to cheapen it, then dump spare energy into Whirlwind.

summary: Race while blocking the 16s: Inflame turn 1, kill the 63 HP Chomper with Bash+/Dismantle/Headbutt+, then the last. Save both potions for Kaiser Crab; finish near full HP.
key_turns: Block all 16 CLAMP hits; SCREECH turns are free damage. Bash+ then Dismantle; kill the 63 HP Chomper first. Skip Barricade/Juggernaut in this short fight.

summary: Chip-and-burst: Inflame and Stone Armor first, block each turn, spread damage evenly across all three segments, then one AOE turn (Bash+ with Whirlwind, Vulnerable potion) kills every segment together so none reattaches.
key_turns: T1-2 setup Inflame/Stone Armor. Chip all segments evenly; never kill one alone (reattaches 25). Burst turn: Vulnerable potion + Bash+ + full-energy Whirlwind. Block hard on BULK-amped WRITHE/CONSTRIC…

summary: Only 59 HP: Bash into Molten Fist (doubled vulnerable) then race with Uppercut/Strikes. Take zero-risk setup on Inhale; block the 12-damage Acid Goop turns. Save the Dexterity potion for Ceremonial Beast's Ringing turns.
key_turns: INHALE (no attack) is the free turn: dump damage, skip block. On ACID_GOOP 7/12 turns block to near-zero damage; kill before the buff loop repeats.

summary: No powers to set up: Bash+ first, then Molten Fist to double vulnerable to 6, dump attacks especially on the ROAR turn, block the 18 hit fully. Hold both potions unless HP drops low; keep HP for the run.
key_turns: ROAR turn (no attack) is the free damage turn: Uppercut/Molten Fist there; full-block the RIP_AND_TEAR 18 hit; kill before a second cycle.

summary: Scaling single elite: Inferno+ turn 1 for steady damage, Bash+ then Molten Fist to double vulnerable, burst with Twin Strike/Uppercut. Block 17-18 hits, race to finish before strength stacks.
key_turns: T1 Inferno+ then Bash+; T2 Molten Fist doubles vuln, then Twin Strike/Uppercut burst. Byrdonis gains strength every turn, so kill by turn 4; drink Dex potion when a 20+ hit comes.

summary: Turn 1 Inferno+ then Breakthrough: 18 AOE kills both small slimes, mids left at 9/16. Then Bash+ into Molten Fist (doubled vulnerable) to burn the mids down fast, keeping HP high for the boss.
key_turns: T1: Inferno+ then Breakthrough (18 to all, kills both smalls). Block POKEY_POUNCE 11 and CLUMP_SHOT 8; Sticky Shot turns are safe — heal at next RestSite.

summary: Open Inferno+, then Breakthrough each turn for 18 AOE. Bash+ into Molten Fist deletes the buffing Jaxfruit first; block Flyconid's SMASH and finish it. Flex potion saved for the boss burst turn.
key_turns: Turn 1 Inferno+; Breakthrough every turn doubles 9 AOE via self-damage. Flyconid's frail-spores then SMASH 13: block the SMASH. Kill Jaxfruit before buffs stack.

summary: Play Inferno+ turn 1 (only 6 damage), then Breakthrough deals 18 to each Nibbit. Focus one down with Bash+ into Molten Fist and Bully; block only when both attack. Save Flex Potion for the boss.
key_turns: T1 only 6 incoming: Inferno+ then Breakthrough for 18 AOE each. T2+ both attack 13/7: block with Shrug It Off if HP low; finish with Bash+→Molten Fist→Bully.

summary: Set up on the charge turns (Inferno+, Bash+), then trade: Breakthrough triggers Inferno every turn. Block the plows, burst below 150 to force the stun, keep Blood Wall for the Ringing turn.
key_turns: T1-2 charge: Inferno+, Bash+. Block the 20/22/24 plows and Crush; push it below 150 for the stun; on the Ringing turn play only Blood Wall.

summary: Race via self-damage AOE: Inferno+ turn 1, Breakthrough each turn hits all bugs twice for 9 (perfect vs the 9 damage cap). Two Breakthrough turns clear 27/29/30 HP. Thorns punish the 1x3 attacker; save potion.
key_turns: T1 play Inferno+, then Breakthrough every turn: 18 AOE, kills the 27 HP bug first, all dead by T3. Block the 8 hit; buff turns are free damage.

summary: Inferno+ turn 1, then race: Breakthrough, Blood Wall and the turn-start HP loss each trigger 9 AOE. Bash+ then Molten Fist for big vulnerable, Bully finisher. Block the 23 BELOW turns; kill by turn 5.
key_turns: T2 BURROW and any STUNNED turn are free: dump attacks. BELOW 23 turns: block fully (Blood Wall/Impervious), don't trade HP.

summary: Inferno+ turns every self-damage into 9 AOE: Breakthrough = 18 AOE for 1 energy, Blood Wall = 18 AOE + 16 block. Race with AOE while blocking ~20/turn; done by T3-4, saving HP for elites.
key_turns: T1: Inferno+, then Blood Wall (block + 18 AOE). T2: ~30 incoming, block fully, Block Potion if short. Egg/Silk die by T3; Rock last.

summary: Turns 1-2 play Inferno+ then Inflame while blocking. Then race: Breakthrough/Blood Wall each trigger Inferno's 9 AOE; prefer single big hits (Bash+/Uppercut/Molten Fist) over multihit to limit Daze; fully block BEES turns.
key_turns: BEES turns (~21-26): block fully, no greed or extra attacks. PHEROMONE_SPIT buff turn is free: play powers and attack. Exhaust Daze with Burning Pact/True Grit; Evil Eye after any exhaust.

summary: Set up Inferno+ and Inflame, then race with self-damage AOE (Breakthrough, Blood Wall, Twin Strike), spreading damage evenly; once all three segments are low enough, kill them in a single turn to prevent reattach.
key_turns: T1-2: Inferno+, Inflame. Keep all 3 segments within ~10 HP; kill ALL in one turn (dead segments reattach at 25). Block the post-BULK buffed attacks (ramp ~+6 str).

summary: Turn 1-2 play Inferno+ then Inflame+ while blocking cheaply; then race, turning Breakthrough/Twin Strike/Blood Wall self-damage into 9 AOE each and finish the 171 HP prism in ~6 turns before its strength snowballs.
key_turns: PULSATE (buff) turn is free: dump attacks. Fully block JAB 15 and multi-hit WHIRLWIND once Vital Spark strength stacks; its damage climbs each cycle, so kill by turn 6-7.

summary: Turns 1-2: land Inferno+ and Inflame+ while blocking cheaply, Bake Gloves ramps Strength. Keep both claws' HP even, hit both via self-damage AOE (Breakthrough, Twin Strike, Blood Wall), and kill both claws in one turn before a second Laser.
key_turns: Rocket's CHARGE_UP turn (no damage): play powers/all-out. The next turn is LASER 45 — stack Impervious + Blood Wall and drink the Skill Potion for a block card. Never kill one claw alone.

summary: Turn 1 is free (enemy buffs): play Inferno+ then Inflame+ to set up the self-damage/Strength engine. From turn 2 block SAVAGE 21 each turn and race with Breakthrough/Twin Strike/Blood Wall triggering Inferno; expect kill by turn 5-6.
key_turns: T1 free: play both powers. T2+: SAVAGE 21 each turn — block fully, Weak from Uppercut; only fit Pyre when you can still block 18+; kill by T6.

summary: Set up Inferno+ and Inflame+ in the first two turns even at some HP cost; then each self-damage card (Breakthrough, Twin Strike, Blood Wall) re-triggers 9 AOE and wipes all three scrolls. Block the 14-damage turns.
key_turns: T1-2: play Inferno+/Inflame+ even eating hits. Every self-HP-loss re-triggers 9 AOE — Breakthrough/Twin Strike/Blood Wall wipe all three. Block the 14-damage turns; finish the buffing scroll first.

summary: Setup fight: Inferno+ and Inflame+ turn 1, Rupture next; ramp strength via self-damage while lightly blocking 25/12; fully wall the 42-cleave turns. Artifact 3 blanks early vulnerability, so strip it before Bash or skip debuffs.
key_turns: T3/T6 WINDUP free - full offense. T4/T7 HEAVY_CLEAVE 42+: Impervious + Shrug/Blood Wall. T1 25 / T2 12: finish powers, block if cheap. Strip Artifact before Bash.

summary: Both idle T1: play Inferno+ then Rupture (Inflame+ next idle turn). Block 29 fully on attack turns, race with self-damage AOE on idle turns, single-target The Lost first; potions only if HP drops low.
key_turns: T2 and every other turn both strike 29 (13+16): full block with Evil Eye/Shrug/Defend+. Idle turns: Breakthroughs plus Bash+ into The Lost, then Molten Fist on vulnerable.

summary: 3-turn race vs 150 HP dummy that never attacks. Turns 1-2: play Inferno+ then Rupture while dumping Breakthrough/Twin Strike (Inferno+ 9 per HP loss, Rupture +1 strength). Bash+ into Bludgeon+/Bully, Unrelenting chains Bludgeon. Potion onl…
key_turns: Dummy never attacks — never block. Turn 3 is the clock: if 150 isn't lethal by then, drink a colorless potion for burst. Keep HP above ~7 (self-damage).

summary: Turn 1-2 debuff-free: play Inflame+/Inferno+/Rupture, block Amalgam's 26. Kill Amalgam first; Baking Glove and Rupture ramp Strength every turn. Then wall Queen's five-hit turns; potions saved for the 44 hits and emergencies.
key_turns: T1-2 no debuffs yet: drop powers while chipping Amalgam (26 hit). After it dies Queen does 44 five-hit then 25: hold Impervious/Blood Wall + potion for those.

summary: Turn 1 Inflame, then Inferno for AOE; kill twig slime, then small leaf slime, blocking the ~15 turn. Skip Barricade in this 58 HP fight. No potions; keep HP high for the run.
key_turns: T2 spikes to ~15 (medium CLUMP_SHOT 8 plus Tackles); kill or block the small slimes first. After that the medium slime alone is a trivial 8/status cycle.

summary: Turn 1 is free: play Inflame and Inferno. Then race the beetle, blocking only on STOMP turns. Skip Barricade. Save Fire Potion for a later elite or boss.
key_turns: T1 Shrinker (no damage): play Inflame then Inferno. STOMP 13 turns (T3, T6): block 13+ or kill first; CHOMP 7 turns just attack.

summary: Set up Inflame then Inferno (AOE ticks on self-damage). Focus Flyconid; slime dies to burn. Block the two SMASH+CLUMP turns, attack the two free turns. Bloodletting = 12 dmg + energy; skip Barricade.
key_turns: T2 and T4 are the ~21-damage turns (SMASH 13 + CLUMP 8): block hard even while frail. T3/T5 are free (0 damage) — full attack; Flyconid should be dead by then.

summary: Play Inflame then Inferno turn 1-2; Inferno's HP loss ticks 6 damage to all InKlets, stripping Slippery. Use Bloodletting for a second AOE tick, then Pommel Strike/Headbutt to clean up while blocking to preserve HP for the act boss.
key_turns: T1-2: Inflame then Inferno (each self-damage tick deals 6 AOE, strips Slippery); incoming ~12 total, block the 2x3 Inklet's hits. Bloodletting = another 6 AOE.

summary: T1 play Inflame + Inferno + block; use Bloodletting to trigger Inferno's AOE (12 total) and gain energy. Race one Nibbit down while blocking the ~20 and 13-damage turns.
